Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation). We work with space technology, launch services and systems used by customers around the world.

With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.

SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.

Do you want to work with software used in rocket and balloon operations? Are you comfortable with technical systems, troubleshooting and close cooperation with operations and IT?

We are looking for a Software Engineer for our Rockets and Balloons department at Esrange Space Center. The role is practical, technical and closely connected to our launch operations.

As Software Engineer, you will develop, maintain and improve software and operational systems used before, during and after rocket and balloon campaigns.

Requirements

We believe you have solid software development experience, work in a structured way and can cooperate with different technical functions.

Additional desired skills include Swedish language skills, experience with C, C++, .NET, C# or Rust, agile methods, test automation, project coordination, a university degree at bachelor level or higher, and leadership experience.

Fluency in English.
Software development and system administration skills.
Experience from Linux and Windows environments.
Deep experience in at least one programming language.
Ability to work in multidisciplinary technical environments.
Structured problem-solving skills and strong communication skills.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will work with software and systems that support safe and efficient rocket and balloon operations.

Design, develop, maintain and improve software systems used for launch operations, mission support and campaign execution.
Manage software configurations, releases, documentation and lifecycle activities.
Support troubleshooting, testing, verification and validation of operational software and related systems.
Participate in procurement, development and implementation projects involving software, automation and operational systems.
Ensure software solutions comply with applicable security, safety and quality requirements.
Collaborate closely with IT and other technical teams across SSC Space.

An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.

Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.
Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.
Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.

This is a full-time, permanent position based at Esrange Space Center in Kiruna.

Every wave of AI capability rests on the infrastructure beneath it. Airon is building that foundational layer — the compute and capacity that the world's most demanding AI workloads run on.

We are growing fast, working with sophisticated international enterprise customers and building the infrastructure required to support increasingly large and demanding AI workloads. This creates engineering challenges that are complex and evolving in real time.

This is a rare window to join. The market is being defined as we build, the technical decisions matter, and the engineers who join us now will have a real opportunity to shape our technology, architecture and engineering culture from the ground up.

Who we are

A tight-knit, high-energy team where people care about what they build, help each other out and have fun along the way.

We build, own and operate our own AI factories in Lidköping, Sweden, running on 100% renewable power, and sell dedicated bare-metal NVIDIA GPU compute to enterprise customers. Everything from the building to the platform is ours, which is why the engineering here is unusually broad.

The role

As AI Solutions Architect, you will be the technical authority in the room when we win strategic customers — and the person who makes sure what we sold is what we can actually deliver.

You will work hands-on with customer AI workloads, our compute platform and the designs that connect the two, taking ownership from first technical conversation through evaluation, proof of concept and onboarding. You will not simply execute against predefined specifications; you will help identify the right problems to solve and influence what we build.

You will work closely with our sales team, our platform and operations teams and our customers' engineers.

What you'll do

Own solutions end-to-end — from architecture and implementation to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.
Contribute to technical decisions and help shape our architecture, engineering principles and ways of working.
Improve the reliability, performance and scalability of our technology as the business grows.
Use AI and modern engineering tools to increase development speed, quality and operational efficiency.
Work alongside our sales team on strategic customers as the technical authority in the room.
Translate customer AI workloads — training, fine-tuning, inference — into concrete compute, network and storage designs on our platform.
Run technical evaluations, benchmarks and proofs of concept, and be honest about fit.
Turn recurring customer requirements into product and roadmap input for our engineering team.
Support onboarding of new customers together with operations, so what was promised is what gets delivered.

We believe you

Have worked hands-on with AI, ML or HPC workloads and understand what they actually need from infrastructure.
Can hold a technical conversation with a customer's engineers and a commercial one with their leadership, in the same meeting.
Have experience from a solutions architect, pre-sales, technical account or platform role facing external customers.
Write and present clearly in English and enjoy being the bridge between customer needs and what we build.
Are comfortable taking work from problem definition to a reliable, working solution.
Can make thoughtful trade-offs between speed, scalability, reliability, security and technical complexity.
Are comfortable working hands-on in an international, fast-moving environment.
Have a genuine interest in using AI and modern engineering tools to improve how software and infrastructure are built.

Bonus points for

NVIDIA GPU platforms and the CUDA ecosystem.
Distributed training at scale, and the failure modes that come with it.
Kubernetes, Slurm or comparable scheduling environments.
Understanding the economics of cloud versus bare-metal compute.
Experience of enterprise procurement and security review processes.
Experience from AI infrastructure, cloud infrastructure, data centers, distributed systems, high-performance computing or another relevant technical environment.
Experience working in an early-stage, high-growth or rapidly changing company.
Experience building systems that support enterprise customers or business-critical workloads.

Who you are

Curious and technically ambitious, with a genuine interest in understanding how things work.
Low-ego and action-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership.
Analytical and pragmatic, with the ability to turn complex problems into working solutions.
Comfortable navigating ambiguity.
Collaborative and direct, with the ability to communicate technical decisions clearly.
Motivated by solving difficult problems and building technology that matters.

What's in it for you

A chance to build the foundational infrastructure behind the next generation of AI — while the market and the technology are still taking shape.

You will work on complex, real-world engineering challenges with significant room to influence architecture, technical direction and how Airon builds. You will join early enough to make a visible impact, take meaningful ownership and help shape the engineering culture as the company scales.

If you have been looking for an engineering role where the problems are genuinely difficult, the pace is high and what you build has a direct impact — this is it.

Practical

Location: Gothenburg preferred; Lidköping or hybrid possible. Travel to customers expected.
We ask all candidates to consent to a background check before starting with us.

About Your Application

Send your application to career@airon.ai. Tell us a little about yourself, what you are great at and what you would like to build with us.

We know that great candidates do not always match every requirement on paper. If this opportunity excites you and you believe you could make an impact at Airon, we would still like to hear from you.

Ready to join us?

Help us build the infrastructure that powers the next generation of AI.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description:
MongoDB is looking for an outstanding person to join our newly created Forward Deployed Engineering team and take on a key role in our extended R&D organization. Forward Deployed Engineering is linking the work of teams engaged on application modernization roles with our Product and Engineering teams.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

Many organizations have built up large estates of legacy applications. Lack of scalability and resilience, long development times, operating cost, and inability to run on cloud are common issues with these applications. To address these issues, organizations are engaging in large transformational Application Modernisation programs. MongoDB is recognized as the developer data platform of choice for transactional systems that provide the best scalability, resiliency and developer experience in the cloud as well as on premises. Organizations are continuously migrating workloads from these legacy applications to new platforms, often based on microservices, using MongoDB.

Such transformations are time intensive and often risky. Tooling based on generative AI promises to accelerate these transformations in a way never seen before. Forward Deployed Engineering is responsible for exploring the possibilities of Generative AI technologies and providing invaluable feedback to MongoDB’s R&D teams to drive future capabilities of MongoDB and the MongoDB ecosystem.

Application Modernization Engineers will work alongside project teams that are executing Application Modernisation projects with customers. The successful candidate will be responsible for evaluation, build, and applying tools in modernization projects, facilitating the usage of such tools and processes across the different project teams, identifying opportunities for tooling deployment, selecting potential 3rd party tools, contributing to the development of tooling prototypes and helping to shape the product roadmap.

Our ideal candidate will have

4+ years of experience as a field engineer or professional services consultant or full stack developer working directly with Enterprise clients
Proficiency in Java or C#, and some familiarity with common database access patterns and frameworks in one or more of these languages
Strong knowledge about enterprise-scale software architectures, application development methodologies, and software deployment and operations
Experience developing enterprise applications using relational databases, and employing SQL and stored procedures with Oracle, MS SQL Server, Sybase and/or PostgreSQL databases
Experience of using and developing with MongoDB and JSON based Document models is highly desirable
Problem solving skills, including the ability to collaborate across disciplines and teams to come up with creative solutions to technical and business challenges
Willingness to dive into a complex domain, ask the right questions, and bring new software tools and technologies to the table to solve customer problems
Great communication skills (both spoken and written), within the team and in customer meetings
Good understanding of Generative AI concepts, tools, and services. Any experience to build new applications/tools using Generative AI is a big plus. That includes Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini, and OpenAI APIs
And finally, a strong interest in how AI supported toolchains can improve application development

Position Expectations

Contribute to customer application modernization initiatives at any or all phases of the application lifecycle: assessment and analysis; planning and design; data modeling; application code conversion, development, test and build; integration and release configuration, production operations, application optimisation, and best practices adoption
Test drive MongoDB migration products to deliver on customer use cases and drive adoption of the product. Deliver concise feedback to the rest of the development organisation
Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to influence the direction of the MongoDB product roadmap
Personally execute POCs including developing or extending existing tools when necessary and appropriate for customer success, with an eye towards reusability and eventual integration with our products. These are often on premises at client locations
Maintain a broad and deep technical understanding of the product line and the underlying technologies and protocols
Work as part of a wider delivery team comprising consulting engineers from MongoDB Professional Services, project managers, and account teams
Assist sales teams in evaluating opportunities with prospects and customers
Willingness to work on site with customers for 7 days per month, which includes regional travel (within Europe)

Success Measures

The Senior Forward Deployed Engineer will be successful in this role when they can execute the following strategic tasks/responsibilities:

Become an expert level user of MongoDB, and our tools current migration products
Develop a playbook for customer application modernization engagements, in collaboration with other MongoDB Engineers, Product Management and Engineering
Communicate complex technical proposals simply and convincingly to a wide range of audiences
Provide unique insight into customer needs, product requirements and strategic opportunities by contributing experience from the field
Gain the reputation as a trusted advisor with our field teams and customers
Contribute to the success of customer application migration initiatives that they support

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

We are hiring a Senior Business Systems Validation Engineer
to join AbbVie Cork. This role focuses on validation and technical support for manufacturing business systems, particularly MES support for SAP and POMSnet. Support validation and production activities for MES systems e.g. EBR and SAP, including system upgrades, issue resolution, continuous improvement, and ongoing production support.

Support the introduction of new products and new technologies, including equipment selection, validation, training, and process support.

Write and execute validation protocol for , cleaning, equipment, utilities, facilities, automation and process.
Support change control activities, validation documentation review and approval, and cross-functional project groups.
Support audit readiness and participate in GMP, corporate, and supplier audits.
Maintain compliance with cGMP, FDA, IMB, GxP, safety, and environmental requirements.
Actively contribute to AbbVie’s operational excellence and digital transformation goals by embracing AI tools, data-driven decision-making, and continuous improvement practices.
Comply with all applicable health, safety, and environmental policies, procedures, and regulations.

5–10 years’ experience in MES/automation systems validation, new product introduction, and/or manufacturing support within a pharmaceutical or GMP-regulated environment.

Experience supporting ERP SAP systems and MES/EBR implementation.

Requirements

Strong experience designing enterprise infrastructure and cloud solutions across one or more major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform).
Solid understanding of hybrid cloud, cloud migration, modernisation, and digital transformation projects.
Experience designing networking solutions including routing, switching, wireless, SD-WAN, VPNs, firewalls, and network security.
Knowledge of virtualisation platforms such as VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix, or similar technologies.
Experience with identity, authentication, and access management solutions (Active Directory, Entra ID, Okta or equivalent).
Good understanding of cybersecurity principles including Zero Trust, endpoint protection, identity security, SIEM, backup, disaster recovery, and compliance.
Experience with automation, scripting, and Infrastructure as Code using technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Python, or CloudFormation.
Understanding of cloud governance, cost optimisation, licensing, and commercial considerations.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and solution design skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Proven experience as a Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant, Presales Consultant, or similar customer-facing technical role.
Experience delivering customer workshops, technical discovery sessions, and solution design engagements.
Strong commercial awareness with experience supporting bids, proposals, and customer presentations.

jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description:
AI Architect role.

We're looking for a hands-on architect who understands what it takes to bring AI into a company successfully, safely, at scale and at speed. In short: you help us move fast without breaking things. You own the build-and-validate phase; a separate team takes proven PoCs to production. Ideal for a solutions architect who's as comfortable coding a prototype as shaping architecture decisions and bringing stakeholders along.

What you'll do:

Build PoCs with the team, then take the proven ones to production or write the spec for the team that will run them.
Solve real problems, finding the pain points, design the fix, ship it and prove the value.
Design for scale where every PoC fits our wider IT landscape and Enterprise Architecture.
Own the architecture that lets AutoStore build AI solutions safely across the company.
Work with the IT teams already building our foundations (data, integration, security, authentication and hosting). You define what AI needs from them and build on top of what they deliver.
Bring people along by explaining choices and trade-offs in plain language, to developers and business leaders alike.

Who you are:

An experienced builder with full-stack developer background.
As comfortable writing code for a prototype as you are making architecture decisions.
You know how data, integration, security and hosting fit together in a large organization.
Nice to have: experience with Azure, Databricks, or taking AI solutions into production.

You'll join a small, empowered team with one task: figure out how to get the most out of AI in what we think is Norway's coolest tech company. (TIME named our robots one of the Best Inventions of 2025, so we're not the only ones who think so.)

AutoStore already builds AI into its products. Now we want to put it to work across the whole company. There is no finished map for this, so we will make the path by walking it. We prototype fast, work closely with the business, and build together with the rest of our exceptional IT team. You'll sit close to the people who do the work, find where AI makes the biggest difference, and build the solutions that prove it. We measure success in business value, not in slides.

How We Work

Think big, start small, move fast. An idea should become a working prototype in weeks, not months.
Build, test, kill, build again. We kill our darlings early, so the best ideas get our time.
Built to grow. We build on our Azure Databricks data platform and follow our IT and enterprise architecture, so what works can scale.
Proven ideas move on. When a prototype proves its value, we take it to production or hand it over to the team that will run it. Then we pick the next problem.
Share what we learn. What we learn at the bleeding edge, we share with the rest of AutoStore as we scale up.

Location: Oslo, Stavanger, or Nedre Vats.

We Offer:

A Collaborative and Inclusive Culture where we celebrate and value everyone’s contributions, encouraging diverse perspectives in decision-making.
Work-Life Balance & Well-being: We offer 1 hour per week of paid exercise, health insurance, and a generous pension plan, prioritizing your mental and physical well-being.
A Creative and Safe Workplace by joining a company experiencing rapid growth, with the stability of being Norway’s first unicorn listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange.
International and Supportive Environment within a Norwegian multinational that values collaboration and innovation.

Application deadline: October 11th
. Please note that we review applications continuously—if this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to apply as early as possible! All inquiries are treated confidentially.

If you are applying from outside of Norway please indicate that you will be relocating to be considered.

AutoStore does not accept agency resumes or assistance for this role. Please do not forward resumes to our job's alias or AutoStore employees. AutoStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. This policy should be respected.

jobs.title: Azure Integration Architect / Presales Architect
jobs.description:
Innostutko asiakkaiden liiketoimintahaasteiden ratkaisemisesta moderneilla integraatio- ja pilvipalveluratkaisuilla? Viihdytkö liiketoiminnan, arkkitehtuurin ja asiakastyön rajapinnassa?

Sijainti: Suomi
Kokemustaso: Mid/Senior

Etsimme kokenutta Azure-integraatioarkkitehtia vahvistamaan Solitan integraatioliiketoimintaa Suomessa.

Roolin kuvaus

Tässä roolissa toimit asiakkaidemme luotettuna neuvonantajana ja osallistut integraatio- ja pilviratkaisujen suunnitteluun aina ensimmäisistä asiakaskeskusteluista toteutukseen asti.
Työssä korostuvat asiakkaiden kanssa työskentely sekä myynnin tukeminen. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä asiakkaiden, myynnin ja teknisten asiantuntijoiden kanssa ymmärtääksesi asiakkaan liiketoimintahaasteet ja muuntaaksesi ne toimiviksi, skaalautuviksi ja turvallisiksi Azure-pohjaisiksi ratkaisuiksi. Pystyt keskustelemaan sujuvasti liiketoimintajohdon kanssa asiakkaan tavoitteista ja haasteista sekä syventymään teknisiin ratkaisuihin arkkitehtien ja kehittäjien kanssa.

Integraatioarkkitehtina mahdollistat älykkään, turvallisen ja liiketoimintaa tukevan järjestelmien yhteentoimivuuden. Suunnittelet ja toteutat integraatioratkaisuja, joiden avulla data ja prosessit liikkuvat saumattomasti organisaation sisällä ja ekosysteemien välillä. Roolissasi yhdistyvät pitkäjänteinen arkkitehtuurityö, toimitusten sparraus sekä AI-avusteisten toimintamallien hyödyntäminen integraatioiden suunnittelussa, toteutuksessa, laadunvarmistuksessa ja dokumentoinnissa.

Johdat teknistä visiota siitä, kuinka järjestelmät kommunikoivat skaalautuvasti, hallitusti ja turvallisesti. Valitset sopivat integraatiomallit, teknologiat ja toimintatavat, määrittelet arkkitehtuuriperiaatteet ja varmistat, että ratkaisut tukevat sekä nykyisiä liiketoimintatarpeita että pidemmän aikavälin IT-strategiaa. Samalla huolehdit siitä, että integraatioiden operoitavuus, laatu, dokumentaatio ja hallintamallit ovat kestävällä pohjalla.

Keskitymme moderneihin API-ratkaisuihin, pilvipohjaisiin integraatioihin ja automaatioon valiten aina asiakkaalle parhaiten sopivat työkalut. Laatu ja parhaat käytännöt ohjaavat kaikkea tekemistämme, ja hyödynnämme aktiivisesti tekoälyä kehitystyön tehostamiseksi ja entistä parempien ratkaisujen tuottamiseksi.

Keskeisiä integraatioteknologioitamme ovat Azure, MuleSoft, Apache Camel. Työskentelemme myös Workaton ja Kafkan parissa. Meillä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisissa projekteissa sekä julkisella että yksityisellä sektorilla.

Kokemuksestasi ja vastuutasostasi riippuen kuukausipalkka tässä roolissa on 5 200–6 200 euroa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Vahva kokemus integraatioarkkitehtuurista ja yritystason integraatioratkaisuista
Kokemusta Microsoft Azure -ympäristöjen suunnittelusta ja hyödyntämisestä
Kykyä toimia sekä liiketoiminnan että teknisten sidosryhmien kanssa
Kokemusta työpajojen, vaatimusmäärittelyjen ja asiakaskeskustelujen fasilitoinnista
Ymmärrystä tekoälyn ja AI-agenttien hyödyntämisestä osana yritysarkkitehtuuria, integraatioita tai liiketoimintaprosesseja.
Erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja esiintymistaitoja suomeksi ja englanniksi
Kykyä muuntaa asiakkaan liiketoimintahaasteet konkreettisiksi teknisiksi ratkaisuiksi
Kokemusta myynnin tukemisesta ratkaisusuunnittelun, tarjousten ja asiakastapaamisten kautta
Ymmärrystä API-arkkitehtuureista, tapahtumapohjaisista ratkaisuista ja pilvinatiiveista integraatiomalleista
Konsultoivaa työotetta ja kykyä rakentaa luottamuksellisia asiakassuhteita

Katsomme lisäksi eduksi

Kokemus Azure Integration Services -ratkaisuista
Kokemus API Management -alustoista
Ymmärrys data-, analytiikka- ja AI-ratkaisujen integraatiotarpeista
Kokemus laajojen arkkitehtuurikokonaisuuksien tai muutoshankkeiden johtamisesta
Microsoft Azure -sertifioinnit

Huomioithan, että useat asiakasprojektimme edellyttävät sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

Millainen henkilö menestyy tässä roolissa?

Viihdyt asiakkaiden kanssa ja nautit teknologian, liiketoiminnan sekä uusien mahdollisuuksien tunnistamisen yhdistämisestä.
Osaat keskustella asiakkaan johdon kanssa liiketoiminnan tavoitteista ja haasteista sekä toisaalta sparrata kehittäjiä ja arkkitehteja teknisissä ratkaisuissa. Näet arkkitehtuurin keinona luoda liiketoiminta-arvoa, et pelkästään teknisinä piirustuksina.
Olet oma-aloitteinen, kaupallisesti ajatteleva ja motivoidut asiakkaiden onnistumisesta sekä Solitan liiketoiminnan kasvattamisesta.

Miksi viihtyisit meillä?

Asiantuntijayhteisö

Osaajayhteisömme tarjoaa mahdollisuuden jatkuvaan oppimiseen ja ammatilliseen kehittymiseen. Arvostamme yhteistyötä ja vahvaa yhteisöllisyyttä projektien ja asiakkaiden välillä. Se on yksi tärkeimmistä syistä siihen, miksi ihmiset viihtyvät tiimissämme.
Vapautta ja joustavuutta

Solitalla työ mukautuu elämääsi, ei päinvastoin. Voit työskennellä mistä päin Suomea tahansa ja meillä on joustava etätyöpolitiikka, asiakastarve huomioiden.
Kattavat edut

Voit valita omat työvälineesi, hyödyntää laajaa työterveyshuoltoa, käyttää hierontaetua, pyöräetua, saada tukea sisäisiltä valmentajiltamme sekä osallistua erilaisiin harrastuskerhoihimme.
Kiinteä kuukausipalkka

Kannustamme oppimiseen, osaamisen kehittämiseen, yhteistyöhön ja tiedon jakamiseen ilman laskutusasteeseen perustuvaa palkitsemismallia.
Mahdollisuuksia kasvaa

Solita Growth Academy, mentorointi ja mahdollisuus siirtyä erilaisiin projekteihin tarjoavat jatkuvia mahdollisuuksia ammatilliseen kehittymiseen.
Vaikuttavia asiakasprojekteja

Olemme esimerkiksi auttaneet metsäkonevalmistaja Ponssea tehostamaan toimintaansa ja kasvattamaan palveluliiketoimintaansa toimittamalla modernin pilvipohjaisen data-alustan sekä integraatiot useisiin tietolähteisiin.

Haluatko liittyä Solitan integraatioyhteisöön?

Jos tämä kuulostaa sinulle sopivalta mahdollisuudelta, lähetä meille CV:si, LinkedIn-profiilisi tai hakemuksesi. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Saila Karonen (saila.karonen@solita.fi).

Keskeisenä teknologia-, data- ja designkumppanina Solitan liiketoiminta perustuu luottamukseen ja vastuullisuuteen. Tästä syystä valitun hakijan henkilöllisyys ja työhistoria tarkistetaan. Nämä tarkastukset suoritetaan työelämän yksityisyyden suojasta annetun lain mukaisesti ja sen rajoissa.
Tässä tehtävässä työskentely voi edellyttää asiakkaamme pyynnöstä tehtävää turvallisuusselvitystä. Turvallisuusselvitys toteutetaan turvallisuusselvityslain mukaisesti, ja sen hyväksytty läpäiseminen on tehtävässä työskentelyn edellytys.

jobs.title: Experienced Software Developer
jobs.location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Build software at scale. Influence how we build it. Help us shape the next generation of development at Dalux.

You will work on products used by professionals around the world, contribute to architectural and technical decisions, and have the opportunity to influence not only what we build, but also how we build it.

Increasingly, this means thinking about how we use AI to make software development more effective.

Your role

As an Experienced Software Developer, you will take ownership of complex product and technical problems from idea to production.

You will work as part of a product team together with other developers, a Product Manager, and a Product Designer. We expect experienced developers to contribute beyond their individual tasks: helping make good technical decisions, improving the codebase and architecture, sharing knowledge, and raising the engineering standard around them.

Depending on your experience and interests, your work can include:

Owning complex features and technical problems end-to-end
Designing and implementing scalable, maintainable solutions
Contributing to architectural decisions and technical direction
Identifying and addressing technical debt where it creates meaningful value
Improving engineering practices, tools, and developer workflows
Driving or contributing to initiatives around infrastructure as code, DevOps, CI/CD, architecture, or developer tooling
Sparring with and mentoring other developers
Working closely with Product Management and Design to understand problems and find the right solutions
Bringing new ideas and technologies into Dalux when they can improve our products or development practices

We expect experienced developers to have opinions, challenge existing solutions, and be comfortable having their own ideas challenged in return.

AI-assisted software development

We are significantly increasing our focus on AI-assisted development across Dalux.

We are actively exploring how AI can improve the software development lifecycle – from understanding requirements and exploring technical approaches to coding, testing, review, debugging, refactoring, and automation.

We do not see AI as a replacement for strong engineering fundamentals. We see it as a tool that can make capable developers more effective when combined with technical judgment and a clear understanding of the problem being solved.

As an experienced developer, we want you to take an active role in this development: experimenting with new workflows, critically evaluating their value, sharing what works, and helping us establish good engineering practices around AI-assisted development.

Practical experience using AI as part of your development workflow is an advantage. More importantly, you should be curious about how these tools are changing software engineering and willing to continue developing your own way of working.

Technologies we work with

Our platform is built on a distributed cloud architecture using AWS.

Our primary technologies include:

C# / .NET
Angular / TypeScript
GitHub CoPilot
MSSQL
Elasticsearch
AWS
Optionally, Android / iOS development using .NET MAUI

You may also encounter parts of our C++ codebase, including opportunities to modernize and improve existing solutions.

Experience with our exact technology stack is useful, but strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand and improve complex systems matter more.

Product development at Dalux

Our product teams bring developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers together.

Developers are expected to understand the problem being solved and contribute to finding the solution – not simply implement specifications handed to them.

As an experienced developer, you will have an important voice in balancing user value, usability, technical feasibility, business viability, and long-term technical health.

Our products are relied upon by professionals worldwide, making performance, stability, maintainability, and quality important parts of everyday engineering.

Your background

We expect that you:

Have solid professional software development experience
Hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related technical field
Have strong software engineering fundamentals
Are comfortable owning complex technical problems and decisions
Care about maintainability, reliability, performance, and quality
Can navigate and improve an established codebase and architecture
Enjoy technical sparring and sharing knowledge with other developers
Are proactive and willing to challenge existing approaches when you see a better solution
Understand the trade-offs between short-term delivery and long-term technical quality
Are interested in how AI and new development tools can improve your effectiveness as an engineer

Experience with C#/.NET, Angular, cloud development, or AI-assisted development is an advantage, but we do not expect you to match every technology we use.

What You Can Expect From Dalux

Dalux is a software company at heart.

As an experienced developer, you can expect:

Significant ownership of the software you build
Real influence on technical solutions and engineering practices
Skilled colleagues who enjoy technical discussion and constructive challenge
Close collaboration between Engineering, Product Management, and Design
Short paths from technical ideas to decisions and implementation
Opportunities to drive improvements beyond your immediate product work
An environment actively investing in AI-assisted software development
High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems
A social workplace with monthly events and employee-driven clubs

All Dalux software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen. Working together in person is an important part of how we collaborate, share knowledge, and make decisions quickly.

About Dalux

Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, Dalux develops user-friendly software used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house, giving our developers the opportunity to influence both the products and the technology behind them.

Interested?

If you are looking for a role where you can remain hands-on while gaining greater technical influence and helping shape how modern software is developed at Dalux, we would like to hear from you.

If you already use AI as part of your development workflow, we would also be interested to hear where you have found it genuinely useful – and where you have not.

We recruit continuously and hire multiple experienced developers throughout the year as Dalux grows.

If you have questions about the position, contact IT Talent Acquisition Specialist Sara at sni@dalux.com

Join our Pizza & Beer event

Sign-up for our free Pizza & Beer event the 29th of October 2026 at Dalux from 16:00: Pizza and Beer with Dalux

During the event, you can hear more about Dalux and the career options through presentations and mingling - all while getting delicious Pizza and beer/drinks!

Hos Nomeco sørger vi for rettidig adgang til livsvigtig medicin samt tilbyder effektive logistikløsninger til medicinalindustrien i Norden.

Som AI Solutions Developer bliver du en del af Data, Analytics & AI. Vi er et team på otte, der dækker BI og analytics, data engineering samt AI og automatisering, og du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med vores Data Scientist & Power Apps Specialist samt kolleger på tværs af IT og forretningen.

Du bliver central i at accelerere udviklingen af AI-assistenter, agentiske løsninger og AI-understøttede processer. Rollen spænder fra prototyper i Microsoft Copilot Studio til produktionsmodne pro-code løsninger på Azure. Vi har allerede AI-løsninger i drift og investerer aktivt i at skalere anvendelsen af AI på tværs af organisationen. Du kommer derfor ind i en organisation, hvor AI er en strategisk prioritet, og hvor der er konkrete løsninger, use cases og forretningsområder at bygge videre på.

Du får mulighed for både at udvikle nye løsninger, videreudvikle eksisterende initiativer og præge vores tekniske standarder og fælles tilgang til AI-agenter.

Identificere og kvalificere AI-use cases sammen med forretningen
Udvikle AI-agenter og assistenter i Microsoft Copilot Studio
Udvikle pro-code AI-løsninger og agentiske workflows på Microsoft/Azure tech stack
Koble AI-løsninger sammen med Microsoft 365, Power Platform, API'er og interne systemer
Arbejde med promptdesign, grounding, RAG, tool calling og orkestrering af AI-agenter
Etablere test, evaluering, monitorering, logging og human-in-the-loop-kontroller, så kritiske handlinger og beslutninger valideres af et menneske
Bidrage til fælles AI-arkitektur, governance og ansvarlig anvendelse af AI samt hjælpe organisationen med at opbygge praktisk AI-kompetence

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du har praktisk erfaring med softwareudvikling og generativ AI, og at du motiveres af at omsætte komplekse teknologier til enkle og værdiskabende løsninger. Du arbejder eksperimenterende, men har samtidig blik for sikkerhed, kvalitet og drift.

Du har typisk en relevant bachelor- eller kandidatuddannelse inden for AI, datalogi, softwareudvikling, data science eller et beslægtet område.

Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:

Kan omsætte et forretningsproblem til en afgrænset AI-løsning og tage ansvar for vejen fra prototype til stabil drift
Har erfaring med softwareudvikling i eksempelvis Python, C# eller TypeScript
Har arbejdet praktisk med generativ AI, LLM’er eller AI-assistenter
Har erfaring med API'er og MCP
Forstår principper for grounding, RAG og integration af AI-agenter med data, API’er og handlinger.
Har erfaring med Git, test og CI/CD
Kommunikerer tydeligt med både udviklere, ledere og procesejere

Det er en fordel, hvis du også har erfaring med:

Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Power Apps eller Dataverse
Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI eller øvrige Azure AI-services
Evaluering og monitorering af AI-løsninger
GitHub Copilot og AI-understøttede udviklingsmetoder

Som person er du nysgerrig og løsningsorienteret, og du tager ansvar for, at det, du bygger, fungerer i praksis. Du trives med at arbejde tæt sammen med forretningen, udfordre behov konstruktivt og finde den enkleste løsning, der skaber reel værdi.

Hos Nomeco får du et spændende og selvstændigt job i et uhøjtideligt og dynamisk arbejdsmiljø, hvor kompetente kolleger står klar til at støtte dig i din hverdag. Du vil få masser af ansvar og gode muligheder for at udvikle dine færdigheder.

Praktisk information

jobs.title: Azure Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Om dit kommende job

Fellowmind Managed Platform – FMP – er vores fælles platform til standardiseret, sikker og effektiv håndtering af kundernes Azure-miljøer. Platformen kombinerer automatisering, governance og managed services i en skalerbarløsning, der løbende udvikles i takt med kundernes behov og Microsofts teknologier.

Som Azure Platform Engineer bliver du en del af hele platformens livscyklus. Du kommer både til at onboarde nye kunder, implementere løsninger og bidrage til den løbende udvikling og drift af platformen.

Du arbejder tæt sammen med kunder, konsulenter, arkitekter og resten af FMP-teamet. Du får gradvist mere indflydelse i takt med, at du lærer platformen, kunderne og vores arbejdsmetoder at kende.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

Onboarding af nye kunder og deres Azure-miljøer på FMP
Implementering og konfiguration af platformskomponenter
Automatisering af deployment, konfiguration og driftsopgaver
Udvikling og vedligeholdelse af Infrastructure as Code
Fejlsøgning og håndtering af tekniske problemstillinger
Test, dokumentation og kvalitetssikring af løsninger
Deltagelse i dialogen med kunder om behov og mulige løsninger
Bidrag til videreudvikling af FMP’s funktionalitet, værktøjer og standarder

Sådan arbejder vi

FMP-teamet arbejder efter principperne i Golazo. Vi deler arbejdet op i mindre, værdiskabende leverancer og afstemmer tilgang og design, før vi går i gang med implementeringen.

Vi betragter ikke en opgave som færdig, blot fordi teknikken virker. Test, dokumentation, monitorering og validering hos kunden er en del af leverancen.

Du behøver ikke kende Golazo på forhånd. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at arbejde struktureret, gøre dit arbejde synligt og give og modtage konstruktiv feedback.

Om teamet

Du bliver en del af vores Cloud, Security & Operations-team og får din daglige gang i det tværfaglige team omkring FMP.

Teamet består af konsulenter og arkitekter med forskellige faglige styrker inden for blandt andet Azure, automatisering, sikkerhed, softwareudvikling og managed services. Vi arbejder på tværs af Fellowminds lokationer og lande oglægger stor vægt på samarbejde, fælles ejerskab og videndeling.

Du får mulighed for at lære af erfarne kolleger og samtidig sætte dit eget præg på platformen og vores måde at arbejde på.

Om dine kompetencer

Der kan være flere veje ind i rollen. Du kan eksempelvis have en baggrund som cloud- eller infrastrukturkonsulent, DevOps engineer, platform engineer eller udvikler med interesse for Azure.

Vi forestiller os at du

Har en teknisk nysgerrighed og et solidt fundament inden for cloudteknologier. Du har praktisk erfaring med Azure eller lignende cloudplatforme og har arbejdet med automatisering, scripting eller Infrastructure as Code. Samtidig har du forståelse for centrale områder som sikkerhed, governance og stabil drift, og du trives med at analysere tekniske problemstillinger og arbejde struktureret frem mod holdbare løsninger.

Du er vant til at dokumentere dit arbejde og dele viden med dine kolleger, og du kan arbejde selvstændigt inden for klare rammer. Derudover motiveres du af at kombinere produktudvikling med konkrete kundeopgaver, hvor du kan omsætte teknologi til værdi. Du kommunikerer professionelt og ubesværet på både dansk og engelsk.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med:

Azure landing zones, governance og identitetsstyring med Azure Policy, RBAC og Microsoft Entra ID
Infrastructure as Code med eksempelvis Bicep, Terraform eller tilsvarende teknologier
Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD samt automatisering med PowerShell, Azure CLI eller lignende værktøjer
Monitorering, logging og observability samt kendskab til Cloud Adoption Framework, Well-Architected Framework eller drift af cloudplatforme

Vi forventer ikke, at du allerede kan det hele. Det vigtigste er, at du har et godt teknisk fundament, er nysgerrig og har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med platformen og teamet.

Om dig

Du går op i kvalitet og tager ansvar for, at dine leverancer fungerer i praksis. Du er nysgerrig, opsøger ny viden og spørger om hjælp, når det skaber et bedre resultat.

Du trives med at arbejde i et team, hvor løsninger bliver kvalificeret gennem dialog og review. Du kan stå på egne ben, men holder ikke viden eller udfordringer for dig selv.

Samtidig har du blik for, at den bedste tekniske løsning ikke nødvendigvis er den mest avancerede. Den skal være forståelig, driftsvenlig og skabe reel værdi for kunden.

Building and maintaining Unity tools like automation, localization, or game data (with great documentation and a strong “others will use this” mindset)

Improving the overall game development experience for everyone through better workflows, reliability, and clarity in our shared tools

Proficiency in C# and a deep knowledge of Unity tooling, including its asset pipeline
Experience shipping iOS and macOS apps with hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and CloudKit, using Xcode and Swift
Experience with performance optimization

jobs.title: Azure Platform Architect
jobs.description:
Om dit kommende job

Fellowmind Managed Platform er vores fælles platform til standardiseret, sikker og effektiv håndtering af kundernes Azure-miljøer. Platformen kombinerer automatisering, governance og managed services i en skalerbarløsning, der løbende udvikles i takt med kundernes behov og Microsofts teknologier.

Som Senior Azure Architect får du en central rolle i platformens tekniske udvikling. Du bliver medansvarlig for, at FMP har en tydelig arkitektur, kan skaleres på tværs af kunder og samtidig er sikker, driftsvenlig og enkel at videreudvikle.

Du arbejder både strategisk og hands-on. Du skal kunne drive en designproces og træffe tekniske beslutninger, men også være tæt nok på implementeringen til at sikre, at arkitekturen fungerer i praksis.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

Sætte teknisk retning for FMP og omsætte den til konkrete, prioriterede forbedringer
Designe standardiserede og skalerbare løsninger på tværs af kundemiljøer
Drive teknisk afklaring og udarbejde korte, præcise designdokumenter
Sikre sammenhæng mellem arkitektur, sikkerhed, governance, drift og kundeoplevelse
Kvalificere komplekse kundekrav og omsætte dem til genanvendelige funktioner og services
Foretage tekniske reviews og sikre kvalitet i design og implementering
Identificere teknisk gæld, risici og muligheder for automatisering
Understøtte onboarding af komplekse kunder og håndtere tekniske eskalationer
Sparre med kunder, arkitekter og interne interessenter om roadmap og løsningsvalg
Mentorere kolleger og bidrage til at løfte teamets tekniske niveau
Skabe fælles standarder, dokumentation og beslutningsgrundlag
Bidrage aktivt til implementering, fejlsøgning og proof of concepts, når opgaven kræver det

Sådan arbejder vi

FMP-teamet arbejder efter principperne i Golazo. Det betyder blandt andet, at vi skaber fælles kontekst, før vi implementerer, begrænser mængden af igangværende arbejde og prioriterer små leverancer, der hurtigt kan valideres.

I rollen får du et særligt ansvar for, at designafklaringen har den rette kvalitet. Det handler ikke om at producere tunge arkitekturdokumenter, men om at gøre mål, afhængigheder, risici, test og væsentlige beslutninger tydelige, mensdet stadig er billigt at ændre retning.

Du bliver ikke den eneste, der må træffe tekniske beslutninger. En vigtig del af rollen er netop at skabe rammer, viden og fælles principper, så teamet kan tage et bredere teknisk ejerskab.

Om teamet

Du bliver en del af vores Cloud, Security & Operations-team og får en central rolle i det tværfaglige team omkring FMP.

Teamet består af konsulenter og arkitekter med forskellige faglige styrker inden for Azure, automatisering, sikkerhed, softwareudvikling og managed services. Vi arbejder på tværs af Fellowminds lokationer og lande, og platformensbeslutninger skal derfor kunne fungere i flere organisatoriske og kundemæssige sammenhænge.

Vi lykkes som team og forventer, at du bidrager med både teknisk retning og plads til andres perspektiver. Rollen handler ikke om at være den person, der har alle svarene, men om at hjælpe teamet med at stille de rigtige spørgsmålog træffe holdbare beslutninger.

Om dine komptencer

Vi forestiller os, at du har en solid baggrund inden for Azure, cloudarkitektur eller platform engineering og har erfaring med at tage teknisk ansvar for løsninger, der skal være robuste, sikre og skalerbare over tid. Du har arbejdet hands-on med Azure-platformen og designet arkitekturer, hvor sikkerhed, governance, drift og fleksibilitet har været centrale hensyn. Samtidig er du komfortabel med Infrastructure as Code, automatisering og CI/CD og ser værdien i at bygge platforme, der er enkle at vedligeholde og nemme at videreudvikle.

Som person er du i stand til at omsætte komplekse forretningsmæssige og tekniske krav til en klar teknisk retning. Du kan hurtigt identificere de væsentligste risici og afvejninger i en løsning og træffe velbegrundede beslutninger på den baggrund. Derudover formår du at kommunikere arkitektur og tekniske valg på en måde, der giver mening for både specialister, kunder og beslutningstagere.

Det er også vigtigt for os, at du trives i en rolle, hvor du gør andre bedre. Du har erfaring med faglig sparring, tekniske reviews eller mentoring og motiveres af at dele viden og skabe retning uden selv at blive en flaskehals for teamet. Du arbejder godt i krydsfeltet mellem langsigtet platformudvikling og konkrete kundeopgaver, hvor du både bidrager strategisk og får tingene til at ske i praksis.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har dyb erfaring med flere af følgende områder:

Azure landing zones og platformarkitektur
Azure Policy, management groups, RBAC og Microsoft Entra ID
Bicep, Terraform eller tilsvarende Infrastructure as Code
Azure DevOps, Git, branchingstrategier og CI/CD
Platform engineering og self-service-koncepter
Security by design og Zero Trust
Monitorering, logging, observability og incident management
Cloud Adoption Framework og Well-Architected Framework
FinOps og optimering af cloudforbrug
Produktudvikling eller udvikling af fælles platformskapabiliteter

Om dig

Du tager ansvar for helheden og interesserer dig både for den tekniske løsning, teamets arbejdsgang og den værdi, kunden oplever.

Du kan træffe beslutninger, når det er nødvendigt, men er samtidig nysgerrig på andres perspektiver. Du bruger review og faglig uenighed til at forbedre løsningen frem for til at forsvare dit eget forslag.

Du er pragmatisk og kan skelne mellem beslutninger, der kræver grundig afklaring, og detaljer, der med fordel kan vente. Du ved også, at en arkitektur først har værdi, når teamet kan forstå, implementere og drive den.

Når noget går galt, søger du efter årsagen i systemet og arbejdsformen frem for efter den skyldige. Du deler din viden aktivt og arbejder bevidst på at gøre teamet mindre afhængigt af enkeltpersoner.

jobs.description:
Date: 24 Sept 2026

Company: Singapore Pools (Pte) Ltd

Work that powers communities.

Who We Are

Singapore Pools was established by the Singapore government on 23 May 1968 to provide safe and trusted betting to counter illegal gambling. As a not-for-profit organisation, it makes contributions to the Tote Board to fund a wide range of causes in social service, community development, sports, arts, education and health sectors.

Since 2004, over $5 billion have been channelled to the Tote Board. In addition, Singapore Pools also contributes about $2 billion annually to the Government in the form of taxes and duties. Its responsible gaming practices have been awarded the highest level of certification (Level 4) by the World Lottery Association’s Responsible Gaming Framework since 2012.

Since inception, Singapore Pools’ staff have a long-standing commitment to doing good and giving back to those in need. Staff volunteers support activities held all year round, from helping disadvantaged children, youth-at-risk, underprivileged families, and elderly, to conserving the environment.

Job Purpose

The Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) drives enterprise operational resilience by architecting scalable cloud infrastructure, managing the enterprise DevOps toolchain, and ensuring centralized system observability across hybrid cloud environments. Leveraging a strong software engineering background, the SRE implements GitOps methodologies and develops custom automation applications and API-based services. By heavily utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and GenAI tools, this role eliminates manual operations, drives efficiency, optimizes cloud expenditures, and ensures maximum system uptime against stringent SLAs.

What You'll Do

Software Engineering & Automation: Write code and develop automated, API-based applications (including GenAI integrations) to streamline operational reporting and eliminate recurring manual tasks.
Reliability & Operations: Implement SRE best practices for observability, availability, performance, and incident response. Define, measure, and govern Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Error Budgets in collaboration with product engineering teams. Participate in on-call rotations, execute postmortem/RCAs, and identify/fix production bottlenecks.
Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure: Support product teams in building fault-tolerant applications by enforcing infrastructure deployment via rigorous IaC code reviews.
CI/CD & Toolchain: Maintain DevOps systems and enforce GitOps workflows and integrate automated security/vulnerability scanning into CI/CD pipelines for all application, container, and IaC deployment approvals.
Observability: Create and maintain consolidated operations dashboards by integrating telemetry from disparate monitoring tools and native AWS/Azure metrics.
FinOps: Generate actionable FinOps reporting to track and optimize hybrid cloud spending.
Resilience & Documentation: Execute disaster recovery (DR), backup, redundancy, and capacity planning strategies while maintaining high-quality runbooks and operational documentation.

Degree-qualified in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Science or related IT Discipline, with 4 to 7 years of proven, hands-on experience in software engineering, cloud architecture, DevOps, or SRE roles.
Hold professional certifications such as ITIL, FinOps Certified Practitioner, AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional), AWS Certified DevOps Engineer (Professional), AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer (Associate), Microsoft Certified Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400).

Automation & Infrastructure as Code (IaC): High proficiency in IaC and configuration management tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation) and container orchestration systems (e.g., Kubernetes). Proven capability in enforcing deployment pipelines through rigorous code review processes and working within Agile methodologies.
Version Control: Proficient in Git, including advanced branching strategies and GitOps paradigms.
Systems Knowledge: Deep expertise in architecting and managing centralized Observability platforms, utilizing GenAI, time-series databases, and diverse monitoring tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace, Splunk, InfluxDB) to trace distributed cloud applications. Solid understanding of Database Administration and Networking architecture.
Professional & Interpersonal Skills: Ability to make sound, logical, data-based decisions on complex issues while considering risks. Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate and build relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Strong interest in technological trends and disruptions impacting Cloud Engineering and SRE.

jobs.title: Manager, Microsoft Agents & Power Platform CoE
jobs.description:
Manager, Microsoft Agents & Power Platform CoE (30000026)

Why this role matters

If you enjoy building high‑quality digital and AI‑enabled solutions, guiding teams through complex automation choices, and helping an organisation scale these capabilities responsibly, this role is for you. This role sits within Changi Airport Group’s (CAG) human resource function and our mission is to attract and retain talents, build sustained capabilities and create an inspiring workplace.

Heading upthe Microsoft Agents & Power Platform Centre of Excellence (MAPP CoE)
at Changi Airport Group (CAG), you will lead a specialist team that designs, builds, and maintains Microsoft‑native automation and AI agent solutions
. This includes Power Automate flows, Power Apps, Copilot Studio (Full) agents, and Azure AI‑based agent solutions.

Your role sits at the intersection of business intent, technical feasibility, and platform quality
. You will lead engineers and Business Analysts (BAs) to help CAG teams automate real work — pragmatically, securely, and at scale — while keeping the Power Platform and Copilot Agents ecosystem robust, well‑governed, and trusted.

You will lead the MAPP CoE to:
1. Build and operate Microsoft‑native AI agents and automation solutions

Design, build, deploy, and maintain task‑specific Copilot Studio agents, Power Automate workflows, Power Apps, and Azure AI agent solutions, with increasing emphasis on agent‑first and headless designs where appropriate.
Ensure solutions integrate securely with enterprise data sources, Microsoft 365 services, and downstream systems.
Remain accountable for solution quality, including reliability, performance, security, and long‑term maintainability, across all assets built or supported by the MAPP CoE.

2. Establish strong lifecycle management for agents and automation

Put in place disciplined practices for versioning, testing, monitoring, and safely enhancing or retiring agents and automated workflows.
Anticipate and manage agent‑specific failure modes such as partial execution, ambiguous outputs, and timely escalation to humans.
Ensure solutions are production‑ready, auditable, and operable over time — not just technically impressive or experimental.

3. Act as the practical guardian of quality, standards, and governance

Work closely with platform owners and Microsoft 365 administrators to shape and refine practical governance controls that safely enable Power Platform and Copilot Agents adoption across CAG.
Contribute hands‑on technical insight to platform governance discussions, helping identify appropriate guardrails, controls, and enablement mechanisms.
Define, promulgate, and uphold best development practices, quality standards, and design guidelines for Power Platform and Copilot agent solutions.
Ensure governance expectations are translated into everyday delivery practices and solution designs within the MAPP CoE.

4. Lead a Business Analyst team that shapes solutions at the front line

Lead and develop a team of Business Analysts who partner closely with business teams.
Ensure BAs can challenge problem statements, guide teams through automation and agent decision architectures, and design sound solution approaches.
Build strong BA capability in translating business needs into clear, implementable solution designs for engineers.
Help BAs stay current with Microsoft agent and Power Platform capabilities so they can confidently advise on what is possible, appropriate, and premature.

5. Enable employees to self‑build simple digital and agentic solutions

Design and deliver practical enablement through brown bags, clinics, playbooks, and consultations to help employees self‑build simple Power Automate flows and Copilot Chat / Lite agents.
Clearly distinguish between solutions that can be safely self‑built by employees and those that should be built and maintained by the MAPP CoE (e.g. Power Apps, Copilot Studio agents, Azure AI agents).
Focus enablement on building understanding of possibilities, limits, and good practices — not on turning non‑technical staff into full‑stack developers.

6. Drive value realisation and impact storytelling

Put in place practical systems to measure, track, and monitor the impact delivered by MAPP CoE solutions on an ongoing basis.
Track both quantitative and qualitative outcomes, including productivity gains, cycle‑time reduction, adoption, solution reliability, employee experience, and cost avoidance.
Communicate the value, impact, and return on investment (ROI) of the MAPP CoE clearly and credibly to stakeholders and leadership, as part of responsible stewardship of resources.

7. Run the MAPP CoE as a focused, high‑impact delivery and enablement outfit

Balance and prioritise capacity across solution build, consultation, enablement, and maintenance.
Lead a hybrid team comprising CAG staff and contingent onshore and offshore resources.
Manage vendor and manpower agency relationships to ensure delivery quality, continuity, and cost‑effectiveness, while minimising long‑term dependency.
Lead the team using pragmatic agile practices. Take time to understand and respect existing ways of working before making changes, improving processes incrementally only where it meaningfully improves delivery outcomes.
Partner closely with other CAG CoEs and technology teams to ensure no wrong doors for employees, smooth hand‑offs, and shared standards.

You must have

A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
Around 8+ years’ experience in software development, automation engineering, platform delivery, or AI‑enabled solution development.
Strong hands‑on experience with Microsoft technologies such as Power Platform, Copilot Studio, and Azure services, or comparable ecosystems.
Experience designing and operating production systems, with a strong focus on quality, security, and lifecycle management.
Experience leading mixed teams of engineers, Business Analysts, and contingent resources.
Strong ability to translate ambiguous business problems into practical, scalable technical solutions.
Comfort operating in evolving problem spaces and keeping pace with fast‑moving AI and platform capabilities.

You would be a great fit if you have

Experience building or operating task‑oriented or conversational AI agents.
Deep familiarity with the Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Copilot, and Azure ecosystem.
Experience working with governance, security, or assurance teams on platform enablement.
Experience managing onshore and offshore delivery teams and vendors.
A pragmatic leadership style that balances experimentation with restraint and sustainability.

What success looks like

The MAPP CoE consistently delivers high‑quality, production‑grade automation and AI agents on Microsoft platforms.
Platform governance and controls benefit from strong, practical input from the MAPP CoE and work effectively in day‑to‑day operations.
Business teams are guided toward the right solution approaches, reducing failed builds, rework, and unmanaged risk.
Employees can confidently self‑build simple automations while relying on the MAPP CoE for complex solutions.
The impact and value of the MAPP CoE is visible, measurable, and clearly articulated to stakeholders.
The MAPP CoE remains trusted, relevant, and resilient as CAG’s Microsoft agent and automation capability continues to evolve.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an AI Solution Architect
to join the CEE IT Digital Solutions team
and lead the design of enterprise AI solutions across the Microsoft ecosystem.

You will define architecture standards, engineering best practices, and reusable delivery patterns that enable teams to build secure, scalable, maintainable, and cost-effective AI solutions. Working closely with various people from developers, business analysts, project managers, security teams, to business stakeholders, you will help shape technology decisions and accelerate AI adoption across the organization.

This is a hands-on role requiring expertise across the full AI spectrum, from low-code solutions built with Copilot Studio and Power Platform
to enterprise-grade AI applications built on Azure AI services and modern AI frameworks
. You will help determine the right architecture, technology stack, and delivery approach for each business scenario.

What You Will Do:

Define AI standards, reference architectures, and reusable design patterns that accelerate consistent, high-quality solution delivery.
Design scalable, secure, and cost-efficient AI architectures and integration strategies.
Design enterprise AI solutions and agentic architectures, including RAG capabilities, voice-based agents, intelligent automation, multi-agent systems, orchestration patterns, and Human-in-the-Loop processes.
Guide architecture decisions across Microsoft AI technologies such as Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and modern AI development frameworks.
Remain hands-on through prototyping, proof-of-concepts, technical reviews, and key implementation decisions, defining approaches for MVP delivery, production deployment, and solution scaling.
Define AI testing, evaluation, monitoring, quality assurance, and success measurement approaches.
Collaborate with governance, security, and risk teams to ensure compliance with enterprise standards and responsible AI requirements.
Support solution shaping, technology selection, effort estimation, and technology adoption decisions, including evaluation of emerging AI capabilities and platforms.
Mentor team members and help grow AI engineering capability across the organization.

What We Are Looking For:

Required Experience

8+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or enterprise application development.
4+ years of experience designing and delivering AI, GenAI, intelligent automation, or machine learning solutions.
Strong experience with Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and Azure AI Search.
Strong understanding of Copilot Studio and enterprise AI solution design.
Solid experience with the Azure platform, including application hosting, integration, security, identity, networking, storage, and data services.
Proficiency in Python or other programming languages and experience with modern software development practices.
Experience designing and integrating REST APIs and enterprise applications.
Hands-on experience with SQL and relational databases.
Experience with GitHub and source control best practices.
Strong understanding of LLMs, Generative AI, prompt engineering, vector search, embeddings, and RAG architectures.
Experience with agent-based architectures, orchestration frameworks, and Human-in-the-Loop solutions.
Knowledge of AI evaluation methods, quality measurements, monitoring, and observability practices.
Understanding of Responsible AI, AI governance, and AI cost optimization principles.
Strong understanding of AI-assisted software development practices, including the effective use of tools such as M365 Copilot, Cursor AI, Claude Code, and similar AI-powered engineering assistants.

Decision-Making Capabilities

You should be comfortable making architecture decisions across:

Low-code vs pro-code approaches.
Copilot Studio vs custom AI solutions.
Single-agent vs multi-agent architectures.
Human-in-the-Loop vs autonomous workflows.
Trade-offs between speed, scalability, security, and cost.

Soft Skills

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences.
Fluent written and spoken English.

Nice To Have:

Power Platform ecosystem knowledge
Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipeline experience.
Microsoft Graph API.
LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, Microsoft Agent Framework, or similar frameworks.
Vector databases such as Qdrant or ChromaDB.
Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric.
Containers, Docker, Kubernetes.
Voice AI and conversational AI platforms.
Experience with frameworks such as FastAPI, Spring Boot, Express.js, or similar.

Overview

🎓
Your internship:

Location: Microsoft Romania

Duration: 12 weeks, full-time

Start: July 2027

Work model: On-site

What if your internship project didn't sit on the sidelines, but contributed to the infrastructure behind one of the world's largest cloud platforms? At Microsoft, interns work on real-world projects with teams across the world. You'll be encouraged to ask questions, experiment, learn quickly, contribute ideas, and make an impact from the start.

Azure Core builds the foundational infrastructure and platform capabilities that power Microsoft Azure. As a Software Engineering Intern with Azure Core, you'll join engineering teams working on the foundational technologies behind Microsoft Azure. You'll have the opportunity to solve real engineering problems, write production-quality software, learn from experienced engineers, and see how systems are designed and operated at cloud scale. Our engineering teams work across areas such as compute, networking, storage, cloud-native technologies, fleet management, operating systems, virtualization, and distributed systems, creating the foundation on which customers build and run applications and increasingly demanding AI workloads.

Depending on your project and team, you could contribute to challenges involving cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, system reliability, performance, security, automation, or AI-enabled engineering experiences.

If you're curious about what happens underneath the cloud and want to understand how software operates at global scale, Azure Core is an extraordinary place to start your engineering career.

🚀 Applications Are Open!

We encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible
, as roles are limited
and highly competitive.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Every day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

As a Software Engineering Intern,
you will:

Apply software engineering principles and creative problem-solving to real technical challenges.
Partner with engineers and other stakeholders to understand requirements and help turn ideas into working software.
Design, write, review, test, and debug maintainable code.
Learn new engineering technologies, methods, and tools and apply them to your project.
Seek feedback and use engineering best practices to continuously improve your solutions.
Work collaboratively while owning your deliverables and managing your project effectively.
Explore opportunities to improve the availability, reliability, efficiency, observability, performance, and security of the systems you work on.
Learn how modern engineering teams use AI and automation to improve how software is designed, built, tested, and operated.

✅
Required Qualifications

Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related technical field with least one semester or academic term remaining after completing the internship.
Programming experience in at least one language such as C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Python, or another object-oriented programming language.
Strong foundation in computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles.
You must be legally authorized to work in Romania to be eligible for this role. (Legally authorized = has citizenship or has been granted a valid visa or work permit).
You communicate confidently in English, written and spoken — you'll work every day with teammates across Romania and around the world.

We're particularly interested in students who bring one or more of the following:

Exposure to cloud computing, distributed systems, operating systems, networking, virtualization, or storage through coursework, research, personal projects, hackathons, open source, or previous internships.
Experience building software projects individually or as part of a team.
Exposure to AI/ML or AI-assisted software development, whether through projects, coursework, APIs, models, or developer tools.
Curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, a growth mindset, and enthusiasm for learning how complex systems work.

You don't need to know everything before joining us. We're looking for people with strong fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn.

Denk je graag mee met de business, durf je een vraag kritisch te bekijken en neem je graag verantwoordelijkheid? Dan zit je hier op je plek.

Voor een Belgische onderneming binnen transport en logistiek
zoekt IN4Matic een Medior Fullstack .NET Developer
. Je komt terecht in een klein intern IT-team dat eigen toepassingen bouwt en onderhoudt. Van een klantenportaal tot koppelingen met transport- en magazijnsystemen: jouw werk helpt klanten hun zendingen op te volgen en collega’s efficiënter te werken.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt aan het eigen klantenportaal, de achterliggende integraties en de verdere automatisering van bedrijfsprocessen. Je denkt mee over wat nodig is en werkt oplossingen uit van technisch ontwerp tot implementatie en opvolging.

Concreet:

Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt het klantenportaal, zowel aan de frontend als de backend, en bouwt mee aan een nieuwe versie.
Je vertaalt operationele vragen naar werkbare software. Je vraagt door, toetst aannames en durft een andere aanpak voor te stellen als die beter aansluit bij de praktijk.
Je bouwt en beheert EDI-koppelingen met transport- en logistieke partners.
Je ontwikkelt API-integraties tussen het portaal, het transportmanagementsysteem, het magazijnsysteem en Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
Je automatiseert rapportering en dashboards om manueel werk voor operationele collega’s te verminderen.
Je onderzoekt productieproblemen, lost bugs op en biedt tweedelijnsondersteuning voor bestaande koppelingen.
Je houdt vanaf het ontwerp rekening met veiligheid, toegangsbeheer, invoervalidatie en gegevensbescherming.
Je gebruikt AI als klankbord in je dagelijkse werk: om ideeën af te toetsen, oplossingen te verkennen en je ontwikkelwerk te ondersteunen. Je blijft zelf kritisch beoordelen wat bruikbaar en correct is.
Je documenteert je oplossingen in Confluence en volgt je werk op in Jira, zodat collega’s ermee verder kunnen.

Wie zoeken we?

Je hebt ongeveer 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring als developer
en kunt zelfstandig een koppeling bouwen, een probleem uitzoeken en een degelijke oplossing opleveren. Wat je kunt realiseren en hoe je meedenkt, weegt zwaarder dan het exacte aantal jaren.

Je brengt het volgende mee:

Een sterke basis in fullstack .NET. Je werkt vlot met .NET, C# en SQL en voelt je thuis in zowel frontend- als backendontwikkeling.
Een stackagnostische blik. Je vertrekt vanuit het probleem en kiest de technologie die past. Je leert graag bij en kijkt verder dan je vertrouwde tools.
Inzicht in transport en logistiek. Begrippen zoals laadmeters, transportplanning en goederenstromen zijn je vertrouwd. Je begrijpt hoe de corebusiness en de bijbehorende IT-systemen op elkaar aansluiten.
Een kritische, communicatieve houding. Je luistert, vraagt door en durft je gesprekspartner constructief uit te dagen. Zo kom je samen tot een betere oplossing.
Ervaring met REST-API’s, JSON en Git, en het vermogen om zelfstandig te debuggen in een productieomgeving.
Aandacht voor onderhoudbare code, testen, veiligheid en duidelijke documentatie.
Interesse in AI en technologische ontwikkelingen. Je gebruikt AI graag als sparringpartner, wilt begrijpen hoe het werkt en onderzoekt welke nieuwe toepassingen echt iets toevoegen aan je werk.
Een dynamische, leergierige instelling. Je legt vlot contact en werkt graag samen met zowel IT-collega’s als mensen uit de operatie.
Een goede kennis van Nederlands en Engels, zodat je in beide talen vlot kunt samenwerken en communiceren.

Mooi meegenomen:
ervaring met maatwerksoftware binnen logistiek, Business Central en AL, EDI/OFTP2, Azure of Azure DevOps. Ook ervaring met een eigen softwareproduct of binnen een klein IT-team is een plus. Interesse in MCP, agentische tooling en het automatiseren van je ontwikkelworkflow sluit goed aan.

Wat maakt deze rol interessant?

Je ziet wat je werk oplevert. Je bouwt toepassingen die klanten en operationele collega’s dagelijks gebruiken. Hun feedback helpt je om gericht te verbeteren.
Je denkt mee over de business. Je krijgt ruimte om processen te begrijpen, vragen te stellen en mee te bepalen hoe software de werking kan ondersteunen.

Job Description

Division

GBS is the software solution delivery factory for Euroclear Core businesses such as Settlement, Asset Servicing, Funds, Collateral, Cash & Banking, and Corporate Services for all entities of the Groups.

The Cash & Banking Tribe is responsible for the design, delivery and evolution of IT solutions supporting Euroclear’s cash management, payments, liquidity, and banking services. The Tribe enables secure, resilient and efficient cash processing across the Group, while driving modernisation, regulatory compliance and operational excellence through close collaboration between business, IT and GBS delivery teams

, supporting Euroclear’s cash management, payments and banking services.

, ensuring architectural coherence, resilience and compliance across the Cash & Banking landscape.

of EasyWay and its ecosystem.

Solution & System Design

Own and design end‑to‑end EasyWay system architectures for the Cash domain, including orchestration, routing and integration flows.
Translate functional and non‑functional requirements into clear, implementable technical designs aligned with event‑driven and service‑oriented architectures.
Ensure solutions meet security, resilience, performance and regulatory requirements.
Validate and evolve existing designs to support scalability, modernisation and technical debt reduction.

Technical Leadership

Act as the senior technical reference for EasyWay, guiding squads on design choices, patterns, APIs and platform usage.
Review and challenge solution designs to ensure architectural consistency and cross‑system coherence.
Support resolution of complex delivery or production issues, contributing to root‑cause analysis and sustainable fixes.

Support squads during implementation to ensure alignment between design intent and delivered solutions.
Collaborate across tribes and platforms to ensure end‑to‑end integration and dependency management.

Identify opportunities to improve robustness, maintainability, automation and operational efficiency.
Promote adoption of modern engineering practices and tooling aligned with Engineering Modernisation.
Share expertise through documentation, coaching and knowledge sharing.

Strong senior‑level experience in software engineering, solution design or system architecture for complex platforms
