Experience delivering solutions with high availability, resilience, security and performance requirements
Solid Knowledge in Angular and .Net development framework
Ability to translate business and regulatory needs into clear, scalable technical designs
Comfortable acting as a technical authority, guiding teams and challenging design decisions

Embark on your new adventure at Euroclear, and work at the heart of the global capital markets. We connect over 2,000 financial institutions across the globe. Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

AI-use cases implementeren
— Functionele noden vertalen naar concrete AI-oplossingen (intelligente assistentie, documentverwerking, samenvatting, extractie, classificatie, kennisontsluiting) op basis van generative AI, LLM's en retrieval/grounding, met voorkeur voor open-source en aandacht voor betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid en gebruikservaring.
I ntegratie met systemen en processen
— Integraties ontwerpen en implementeren tussen AI-componenten en interne applicaties, API's, databronnen en documentstromen, robuust ingebed in bestaande workflows, met toegangsbeheer, auditing en input/output-validatie.
Evaluatie en kwaliteitsborging
— Evaluaties, testscenario's en reviewflows opzetten met oog voor relevantie, nauwkeurigheid, grounding en veiligheid, en prompts, retrieval-logica en output-structuren verbeteren op basis van resultaten.
Productionisering en monitoring
— POC's vertalen naar productieklare AI-services met deployment-aanpak en versiebeheer, en monitoring/observability voorzien (logging, traces, latency, foutpercentages, gebruik, inferentiekosten) om problemen tijdig te signaleren en verbeteren.
Samenwerking en kennisdeling
— Afstemmen met developers, architecten, product owners, security en business stakeholders, goede praktijken en documentatie verzorgen, en kennis delen rond het verantwoord en effectief inzetten van AI.

Profiel

Je beschikt over een Bachelor of Master in de Informatica of je kan gelijkwaardige ervaring aantonen. Je hebt minimum 2 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol.

Je hebt een sterke expertise in:

Python en backend- of integratieservices
SQL en dataverwerking in productiecontext
API’s, SDK’s en systeemintegraties (incl. C#/.NET)
Generative AI en LLM-toepassingen (incl. retrieval/grounding en prompt flows)
Documentverwerking, informatie-extractie, classificatie en kennisontsluiting
Integratie van AI-oplossingen in applicaties en (on-premise) omgevingen
Logging, tracing, monitoring en observability voor AI-toepassingen
CI/CD, versiebeheer en deployment van AI-services
Best practices rond algoritmische regulering

Ervaring met containerisatie, cloud services of platformdiensten voor AI, vector databases, embeddings en retrieval-patterns, evaluatieframeworks, structured outputs en document intelligence-oplossingen is een pluspunt.

Je bent resultaatgericht en pragmatisch: je bent in staat om AI-oplossingen om te zetten naar bruikbare en betrouwbare productiefunctionaliteit.

Je beschikt over een sterk analytisch en systematisch denkvermogen, met oog voor trade-offs, risico’s en haalbaarheid.

Je neemt ownership over technische realisaties binnen toegewezen use cases of componenten.

Je hebt een bewustzijn van kwesties op het gebied van naleving, ethiek en governance van AI-systemen, met name gezien de specifieke risico’s van LLM’s (hallucinaties, vooringenomenheid, datalekken).

Je bent communicatief sterk en kan technische keuzes helder toelichten aan zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders.

Je bent samenwerkingsgericht en vlot inzetbaar in een multidisciplinaire context.

Tot slot heb je een passieve kennis van het Frans en het Engels.

Wij bieden

Je krijgt een gevarieerde, uitdagende en maatschappelijk relevante job
waarbij je bijdraagt aan IT-oplossingen die een belangrijke rol spelen in de samenleving. Onze slogan 'ICT for society' weerspiegelt dit perfect.

.

zoals hospitalisatieverzekering, aanvullend pensioenplan, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques,… IT-functies kunnen rekenen op een mobiliteitsbudget

jobs.description:
Talan – Positive Innovation

Talan is an international consulting group specializing in innovation and business transformation through technology. With over 7,200 consultants in 21 countries and a turnover of €850M, we are committed to delivering impactful, future-ready solutions.

Talan at a Glance

Headquartered in Paris and operating globally, Talan combines technology, innovation, and empowerment to deliver measurable results for our clients. Over the past 22 years, we’ve built a strong presence in the IT and consulting landscape, and we’re on track to reach €1 billion in revenue this year.

Our Core Areas of Expertise

Data & Technologies:
We design and implement large-scale, end-to-end architecture and data solutions, including data integration, data science, visualization, Big Data, AI, and Generative AI.

Cloud & Application Services:
We integrate leading platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, Microsoft, AWS, and IBM Maximo, helping clients transition to the cloud and improve operational efficiency.

Management & Innovation Consulting:
We lead business and digital transformation initiatives through project and change management best practices (PM, PMO, Agile, Scrum, Product Ownership), and support domains such as Supply Chain, Cybersecurity, and ESG/Low-Carbon strategies.

We work with major global clients across diverse sectors, including Transport & Logistics, Financial Services, Energy & Utilities, Retail, and Media & Telecommunications.

Job Description

In this senior engineering position, you will take a strongly hands-on part in shaping and delivering robust software solutions supporting electronic trading and pricing workflows. The role calls for solid technical depth, extensive practical command of modern .NET development, and the confidence to take on intricate platform components. It represents a compelling chance to help build a brand-new greenfield platform in the fixed income electronic trading space, developed on AWS and current .NET technologies, where engineering excellence, reliability and production-ready delivery are central.

What would you be doing?

Architect, develop and maintain reliable .NET software components throughout every stage of the delivery lifecycle.
Assume direct, hands-on ownership of technically demanding platform components, keeping them resilient, maintainable, scalable and properly documented.
Exercise sound engineering judgement across architecture, design, implementation, testing and operational concerns.
Collaborate closely with trading, product, architecture, infrastructure and partner technology teams so that delivered solutions match business priorities.
Help strengthen engineering standards, including test automation, observability, secure coding, CI/CD and sound release management.

Qualifications

What are we looking for?

Expert command of C# and .NET/.NET Core, underpinned by a firm grasp of object-oriented design, SOLID principles and clean architecture.
Substantial background designing, developing and supporting ASP.NET Core Web APIs and RESTful services running in production.
Advanced knowledge of multi-threading, asynchronous programming, performance optimisation and distributed system design.
Demonstrated experience across SQL and NoSQL databases, covering data modelling, performance factors and operational support.
Practical exposure to containerisation technologies such as Docker, along with current deployment approaches.
Solid track record designing and delivering API-driven service-oriented or microservice architectures.
Rigorous approach to automated testing, spanning unit, integration and behaviour-driven testing with tools such as NUnit, Moq and Cucumber.
Wide-ranging experience with messaging and event-driven architectures based on technologies like RabbitMQ, TIBCO, SignalR or comparable platforms.
Considerable experience with continuous integration, continuous delivery and version control tooling such as Git, TeamCity or equivalent.
Real-world experience working within Agile delivery teams and helping refine the software lifecycle.
Background supporting live production systems, troubleshooting incidents and enhancing reliability, monitoring and operational readiness.
Advanced English (required). Spanish is a plus

Additional Information

What do we offer you?

We offer:

Full-time and permanent employment contract or contractor mode
Remote location in Spain (other EU or Latam countries will be taking in count)
Professional growth possibilities & learning opportunities
Possibility to join a multicultural team & work in the international environment
Variety of benefits to support your physical, emotional and financial wellbeing: private medical insurance, life insurance, lunch and transport card as part of the flexible remuneration pack, and online language classes
Smart Office Pack

If you are passionate about data, development & tech, we want to meet you!

jobs.location: Sant Cugat del Vallès, Catalonia, Spain
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are

At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

The Opportunity

You will be joining one of the Agile organisations in charge of designing, implementing, delivering and maintaining Reusable solution to simplify interoperability between diagnostics solutions (Roche and non-Roche instrumentation, LIS, HIS, Edge Systems…) to simplify the development to reduce complexity, time to market, cost of ownership and quality of our internal customers within R&D Departments at Roche Diagnostics.

This position will play a critical role in the team, leveraging deep expertise in Connectivity protocols and solutions and supporting the design, development, deployment and validation of future connectivity solutions while maintaining the current base of deployments across Roche. As a Software Engineer, you will be also lead the ASDLC adoption and Ways of working in your team while preserving quality standards and good software practices. You are expected to show a good customer centric mindset.

For this you will prove experience in .NET Software Development, Instrument connectivity protocols and Interoperability in general. You can communicate effectively in English with people of different profiles, cultures and your mentoring skills shall contribute to continuous improvement and delivering excellent software efficiently.

You will be responsible

You care about your team, leading technical discussions and complex initiatives. You can influence decisions within your area of responsibility and connect naturally with business and architecture representatives to provide solutions to our customers. You are able to manage technology, business and reality to design future feasible and efficient solutions.

Who you are:

Healthcare Interoperability & Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of healthcare and laboratory integration standards (e.g., HL7, POCT1-A, ASTM, LIS/HIS) and connectivity solutions for diagnostics environments
Software Development & Quality Practices: Proven hands-on C# .NET development background with strong expertise in software design patterns, object-oriented design, TDD/BDD, unit/integration testing, and maintainable code
End-to-End Ownership & AI Integration: Track record of full SDLC responsibility (from requirements to deployment), including integrating AI toolsets into development workflows and understanding cloud/frontend technologies
Technical Leadership & Architecture: Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentor developers, design robust components, and guide architecture/AI strategy alongside product managers and stakeholders
Education, Communication & Soft Skills: Degree in CS or related field (Bachelor's + 6 years or Master's + 4 years), with strong problem-solving skills, independence, and fluent communication in English and Spanish for agile, cross-functional collaboration

Locations

You will be based in Sant Cugat, Spain.

Leadership Skills

You are also responsible for building, and then providing effective leadership for your team. Doing so in a manner that is consistent with the Roche Values and leadership capabilities. You will seek to inspire and lead your team to create transformative solutions, and to influence their prioritization and uptake in the wider organization, in order to ensure that customer solutions are at the forefront of the market and deliver its optimal contribution to the Roche Diagnostics Vision.

Both Diagnostics and Diabetes Care Leadership teams use these skills when referring to leadership. Consider bringing them into the job description.

The Expert SW Engineer in Mobile is expected to demonstrate the Roche Operating Principles and contribute to the Roche Group. The Roche Operating Principles are:

Put patients first
Follow the science
Act as one team
Embrace differences
Accelerate learning
Simplify radically
Make impact now
Think long term

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Liderar procesos de preventa y respuestas a RFP complejas y de gran envergadura .
Coordinar la elaboración de propuestas, estimaciones económicas, modelos de prestación y planes de trabajo.
Realizar defensas comerciales y técnicas ante interlocutores de negocio y tecnología.
Definir propuestas de valor y soluciones alrededor de:
Data Strategy y Data Assessments.
Modern Data Platforms y Data Lakes.
Arquitecturas de datos cloud, híbridas y on-premise.
Business Intelligence y Analytics.
DataOps y MLOps.
Plataformas de streaming y procesamiento en tiempo real.

Desarrollar relaciones con alianzas y partners tecnológicos, identificando oportunidades conjuntas de mercado.

Dirección de proyectos y gestión económica

Dirigir de forma concurrente una cartera aproximada de tres o cuatro proyectos .
Asegurar el cumplimiento de los compromisos de alcance, calidad, plazo y presupuesto.
Gestionar riesgos, dependencias, planificación, capacidad y carga de los equipos.
Realizar el seguimiento financiero de los proyectos, incluyendo ingresos, costes, margen, previsiones y desviaciones.
Mantener una interlocución ejecutiva con los clientes durante todo el ciclo de vida de los proyectos.
Participar en la resolución de situaciones críticas, facilitando la toma de decisiones y la definición de planes de acción.
Asegurar la calidad de los entregables y la coherencia de las soluciones con los objetivos del cliente.

Liderazgo técnico y de solución

Liderar la definición de arquitecturas y soluciones de datos desde una perspectiva de management, viabilidad, valor y posicionamiento comercial .
Orientar a los equipos en la selección de tecnologías, patrones arquitectónicos y modelos de implantación.
Conectar las necesidades de negocio con soluciones de ingeniería y arquitectura de datos escalables, seguras y sostenibles.
Participar en revisiones de arquitectura, estimaciones, planes de transición y hojas de ruta tecnológicas.
Identificar riesgos técnicos y operativos durante las fases de preventa y ejecución.

Gestión y desarrollo de equipos

Liderar equipos de entre 10 y 20 profesionales , con capacidad para asumir estructuras superiores a 20-25 personas a medida que crezca la práctica.
Coordinar managers, arquitectos, especialistas, consultores y perfiles de ingeniería.
Crear equipo y desarrollar capacidades, favoreciendo la incorporación, formación y evolución de nuevos profesionales.
Realizar seguimiento del desempeño, desarrollo profesional, asignación y cargabilidad de los equipos.
Promover la colaboración, la autonomía y la transmisión de conocimiento.
Actuar como referente para el equipo, generando metodología, buenas prácticas y una cultura de excelencia técnica y orientación al cliente.

¿Qué perfil buscamos?

Experiencia profesional

Experiencia previa de más de 2 años desempeñando funciones de Gerente en proyectos de Data, Analytics, Cloud o transformación tecnológica.
Experiencia contrastada en la dirección técnica y económica de proyectos de consultoría.
Experiencia gestionando simultáneamente varios proyectos, con responsabilidad sobre plazos, riesgos, presupuesto, margen y equipos.
Experiencia en el desarrollo y gestión de grandes cuentas.
Experiencia liderando preventas, propuestas y respuestas a RFP.
Capacidad para definir y defender arquitecturas y soluciones de datos ante interlocutores técnicos y ejecutivos.
Experiencia en gestión de equipos de más de 10 personas.
Se valorará experiencia gestionando una unidad, cartera de proyectos o cuenta con responsabilidad sobre su rendimiento económico.

Formación

Titulación universitaria en:
Ingeniería Informática.
Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones.
Ingeniería Industrial.
Matemáticas.
Física.
Otras titulaciones técnicas equivalentes.

Idiomas

Inglés fluido (b2/c1, preferiblemente c1). Debes ser capaz de liderar reuniones, defender una arquitectura y redactar documentación técnica compleja en inglés.
Capacidad para participar en propuestas, reuniones y presentaciones en entornos internacionales.

Conocimientos tecnológicos

Buscamos un perfil con visión amplia de las arquitecturas de datos y capacidad para tomar decisiones y liderar soluciones. No es imprescindible ser especialista técnico hands-on en todas las tecnologías, pero sí disponer de conocimiento suficiente para orientar propuestas, validar arquitecturas y mantener conversaciones de alto nivel con clientes y equipos técnicos.

Se valorará el grado de experiencia en los siguientes ámbitos:

Arquitecturas y plataformas de datos

Arquitecturas de Analytics en entornos cloud, híbridos y on-premise.
Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, Lakehouse y Modern Data Platforms.
Procesamiento batch, streaming y arquitecturas orientadas a eventos.
Integración, gobierno, seguridad y calidad del dato.
DataOps, DevOps y MLOps aplicados a plataformas de datos.

Cloud y plataformas analíticas

Microsoft Azure : Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Synapse Analytics, Azure SQL, Analysis Services, Databricks, Delta Lake y Power BI.
Google Cloud Platform : Cloud Storage, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery y herramientas de visualización del ecosistema Google Cloud.
Amazon Web Services : AWS Lambda, Glue, S3, Redshift, Athena, Redshift Spectrum y Kinesis.
Snowflake .
Databricks .

Ingeniería e integración de datos

Apache Kafka, Kafka Connect y tecnologías de procesamiento de eventos.
Ecosistemas Hadoop y plataformas como Cloudera.
Bases de datos SQL, incluyendo Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server y MySQL.
Herramientas y patrones de integración, transformación y explotación de datos.

Certificaciones valorables

Se valorarán certificaciones profesionales relacionadas con:

Microsoft Azure.
Google Cloud Platform.
Amazon Web Services.
Snowflake.
Databricks.
Gestión de servicios y proyectos, como ITIL o PMP .

Las certificaciones serán consideradas un elemento positivo, aunque se priorizará la experiencia real en gestión de clientes, desarrollo comercial, liderazgo de equipos y dirección de proyectos.

Competencias clave

Orientación al cliente

Capacidad para comprender las prioridades del cliente, construir relaciones de confianza y convertir necesidades de negocio en iniciativas y soluciones concretas.

Comunicación e influencia

Comunicación ejecutiva, clara y convincente. Capacidad para presentar y defender propuestas ante responsables de negocio, CIO, CDO, responsables de arquitectura y equipos técnicos.

Autonomía comercial

Capacidad para desarrollar relaciones con clientes, abrir oportunidades, movilizar equipos internos y liderar defensas comerciales con poca dependencia de terceros.

Capacidad comercial

Experiencia liderando RFP complejas, articulando propuestas de valor, definiendo soluciones y coordinando los componentes técnicos, económicos y operativos de una oferta.

Liderazgo

Capacidad para dirigir equipos multidisciplinares, delegar responsabilidades, desarrollar talento y acompañar el crecimiento de la práctica.

Trabajo en equipo

Orientación a crear capacidad sostenible, compartir conocimiento y generar una comunidad de profesionales alrededor de la ingeniería y arquitectura de datos.

Gestión económica

Solidez en la elaboración y seguimiento de presupuestos, estimaciones, márgenes, previsiones, asignaciones y planes de capacidad.

Iniciativa y proactividad

Capacidad para anticipar necesidades, identificar oportunidades y tomar decisiones en contextos complejos o con información incompleta.

Visión tecnológica y de negocio

Capacidad para valorar una solución no solo por su adecuación técnica, sino también por su viabilidad económica, escalabilidad, impacto y alineamiento con la estrategia del cliente.

Otros requisitos

Flexibilidad para trabajar con diferentes industrias, clientes y equipos.
Capacidad para desenvolverse en entornos de crecimiento, transformación y elevada exigencia.
Orientación a resultados, calidad y generación de impacto.

jobs.title: Solution Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role:

As a Pre-Sales Solutions Engineer, you will act as the technical lead throughout the sales cycle, partnering closely with Account Managers to support new business and growth opportunities.  
You will take a consultative approach, helping customers understand how AvePoint solutions can address their technical and business needs. This role combines strong technical expertise with customer-facing engagement and commercial awareness.  
This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop their career in pre-sales within a fast-paced and innovative technology environment.  

Key responsibilities:

Support customers through evaluation, proof-of-concept and decision-making stages
Build and configure demo and proof-of-concept environments
Contribute to RFI/RFP responses, articulating business value and technical capability
Partner with Sales to understand customer objectives and position solutions effectively
Build strong relationships with key business and technical stakeholders
Support partner and marketing activities including events, webinars and workshops  
Provide feedback to product and technical teams on market trends and customer requirements
Take ownership of the technical aspects of deals through to close
Act as a technical evangelist for the business, representing the company at industry events, webinars, customer workshops, partner sessions, and community forums.
Develop and promote a professional presence within the Microsoft ecosystem and wider technology community through thought leadership, content creation, speaking engagements, and networking activities.
Support brand awareness and pipeline generation by sharing market insights, customer success stories, and technical expertise across internal and external channels.
Deliver compelling presentations to both technical and executive audiences, translating complex concepts into clear business value.
Contribute to the growth of the company's market presence by building credibility, influence, and trusted relationships within target customer and partner communities.

What you will bring:

Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience  

Strong presentation and communication skills, with confidence engaging with technical and non-technical stakeholders  

Fluent in English (additional European languages are advantageous but not required)  

Ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value  

Commercial mindset with an interest in sales and customer outcomes  

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills  

Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment  

Adaptability and willingness to learn in a fast-changing environment  

Technical skills:

Experience with Microsoft 365 technologies (including SharePoint Online)  

Knowledge of Microsoft Azure and identity technologies (e.g. Entra ID)  

Understanding of identity, access and permissions management  

Familiarity with networking basics (TCP/IP, DNS, Active Directory, SMTP, DHCP)  

Knowledge of data protection, backup, migration, and governance concepts  

Understanding of SharePoint architecture and cloud/hybrid environments  

Broader awareness of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) is beneficial  

Working at AvePoint:

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels supported and valued. We believe that different perspectives strengthen our teams and enable us to deliver better outcomes for our customers.  

Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Company

The Best of Both Worlds

At Maisa, we believe great work happens when people have the freedom to choose the setup that works best for them.

Prefer the flexibility of remote work?

You’re welcome to work remotely. Most of our roles are currently focused on Spain, although depending on the position and profile, we may be open to hiring from other locations.

Looking for some social energy?

Our hybrid setup gives you the option to connect and work alongside teammates at our hubs in Valencia, Barcelona, Madrid and Murcia

. And as we grow, our spaces will grow with us: when we build a team of more than 10 people in a location, our ambition is to create a hub there too.

We also want the time we spend together in person to be worth it. Today, that includes weekly transportation from the city center to our Valencia headquarters

and weekly team lunches in Valencia and Barcelona

, with more experiences to come as our teams and hubs evolve.

The Culture is OURS to Create

We’re still shaping how we work together—and that’s part of what makes joining Maisa now specifically exciting.

Everyone who joins has the opportunity to influence how we collaborate, connect, and build our culture. Rather than inheriting a finished playbook, you’ll have a voice in creating it.

Remote when you want flexibility. Together when you want connection. And a culture you can help shape from day one.

Welcome to Maisa – Making AI Accountable!

Maisa is building the next generation of Agentic Process Automation
, helping enterprises automate complex, decision-heavy processes that traditional automation can’t handle and GenAI alone can’t be trusted with. Our platform combines AI-driven reasoning with deterministic execution, enabling reliable, auditable, and enterprise-ready AI systems.

About The Role…

We’re seeking Forward Deployed Engineers to work at the intersection of engineering, product, and customers, deploying and adapting Maisa Studio
, our flagship Agentic Process Automation platform, to solve real-world enterprise problems.

Customer-Facing Engineering
Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their processes and goals. Design and implement solutions using Maisa Studio to automate complex workflows, acting as a trusted technical partner during onboarding and deployment while translating requirements into technical implementations and product feedback.

Collaboration & Product Feedback
Partner with product and engineering teams to influence roadmap development. Surface customer needs, edge cases, and scalability concerns while defining best practices, reference architectures, and reusable components that accelerate delivery.

Reliability, Security & Quality
Ensure deployments meet enterprise standards for reliability, performance, and security. Support customers in regulated environments by aligning with compliance requirements and collaborating with QA, SRE, and AppSec teams for stable rollouts.

What You’ll Do…

You will work closely with enterprise customers and internal teams to deliver robust, secure, and maintainable deployments in complex, often regulated environments, across 2 key technical domains:

Integrations & Supporting Services (Build what makes the use case work)

Configure, extend, and integrate Maisa Studio into customer environments, designing end-to-end solutions that include APIs, connectors, webhooks, serverless functions, microservices, and event-driven flows. Translate functional requirements from Automators and Technical Account Managers into concrete technical implementations using Go, Python, or JavaScript, clarifying ambiguities and proposing pragmatic paths forward. Ensure robustness through strong engineering practices including testing, logging, monitoring, and documentation. Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems and support handover to internal teams or customers when applicable.

Customer Infrastructure Deployments / DevOps (On-prem & Customer Cloud)

Design and support deployments of Maisa Studio in customer environments, including on-premise and customer-managed cloud infrastructures. Work closely with customer DevOps, SRE, and Security teams to achieve production readiness, configuring platform requirements including authentication (OIDC, SAML), IAM, networking (VPNs, DNS, ingress/egress), and operational controls (deployment pipelines, monitoring, backups, high availability). Diagnose and resolve deployment-level incidents, ensure the platform operates within customer security and compliance requirements, and produce clear operational documentation including runbooks, deployment patterns, and troubleshooting guides.

What You’ll Bring…

You have strong experience as a Software Engineer, Solutions Engineer, DevOps/SRE Engineer, or Forward Deployed Engineer in customer-facing or delivery-oriented roles. You're comfortable operating in ambiguous environments, moving quickly from problem to solution while maintaining reliability, with strong troubleshooting skills across code, integrations, and infrastructure. You bring a customer-first mindset and can explain technical concepts clearly to drive alignment.

We are seeking candidates with one of two skill sets, or a mix of both:

Integrations & Supporting Services (Build what makes the use case work)

Strong experience as a backend or full-stack developer shipping production systems.
Hands-on experience with APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures/queues.
Familiarity with serverless and integration patterns commonly used in enterprise environments.
Strong debugging skills and comfort operating across code, infrastructure touchpoints, and workflow logic.

Customer Infrastructure Deployments / DevOps (On-prem & Customer Cloud)

Strong experience in DevOps / SRE, supporting production workloads.
Hands-on knowledge of Kubernetes, cloud providers and/or on-prem infrastructure, and networking fundamentals.
Practical experience with security and identity standards: OIDC, SAML, VPNs, certificates, and IAM concepts.
Ability to quickly understand customer infrastructure and adapt to their tools and processes.
Clear, structured communication with technical stakeholders in customer organizations.

Why join Maisa!

You will be joining one of Europe’s most exciting early-stage AI start-ups, where you’ll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge Agentic Process Automation that’s reshaping how enterprises approach AI deployment. You will get to directly influence how major multinational organizations transform critical business processes, working on genuinely differentiated technology that solves real enterprise AI challenges.

Following our recent $25m Seed Round, backed by leading Venture Capital firms including Creandum, Forgepoint, NFX, and Village Global, we’re scaling quickly and realising significant enterprise traction. This is your opportunity to help solve real AI enterprise challenges, working alongside deep technical and industry experts, where you will be challenged daily and expedite your learning and development.

Maisa is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all.

By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.

Edebex is Hiring!

We are looking for a Software Developer with strong .NET development skills and a genuine interest in Artificial Intelligence to join our IT team.

You will contribute to the development of a strategic AI-powered solution while also supporting the continuous evolution of our business applications. The role offers a mix of automation projects, feature development, maintenance, and technical improvements within systems that support our day-to-day operations.

As part of a small and collaborative team, you will work closely with fellow developers, the product owner, Q&A and business stakeholders to design, develop, and improve software solutions that directly support the company's operations and growth.

About us!

Edebex is a FinTech platform helping companies optimize their cash flow through smart, data-driven financing solutions — without taking on additional debt.
We connect businesses seeking faster liquidity with investors looking for short-term, high-performance investment opportunities.
With over €2 billion in invoices financed and continuous growth across Europe, Edebex is driving a more dynamic and data-powered economy — one invoice at a time.

Your mission

AI & Automation Projects
Contribute to the development of a strategic automation platform that streamlines business-critical processes.
Develop components that process and analyze business documents, communications, and related data.
Integrate AI services and business rules into existing applications and workflows.
Design and implement integrations between various internal systems, databases, APIs, and external services.
Contribute to the development of a user interface that helps employees review, validate and manage automated results.
Design and develop reliable, explainable and maintainable solutions with appropriate logging, traceability, and audit trails.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand operational processes and translate them into practical software solutions.

Business Application Development
Develop and implement new functionalities, enhancements, and integrations within the company's core business applications.
Participate in the analysis and resolution of incidents and bugs.
Contribute to technical improvements and refactoring initiatives.
Participate in team meetings to discuss progress and resolve potential blockers.

Required Skills & Experience

5+ years of experience as full stack developer
Strong experience with C# and .NET development

Experience with SQL Server
and database design
Experience developing and consuming APIs
Good understanding of software architecture and design principles
Experience with Git and modern development practices
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (French is a plus)
Experience with AI is a strong plus, in particular with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs and Document Intelligence. But a genuine interest and willingness to learn are equally important.
Experience with React and Blazor is a plus

A fast-growing FinTech environment with a collaborative and close-knit team

100% remote

You will help teams choose where Generative AI adds value, build secure and scalable solutions, and measure their quality and cost in production.

Your responsibilities will include:

Solution Architecture & Delivery

Lead the architecture and delivery of Generative AI solutions, guiding development teams on relevant tools, frameworks, and platforms.
Translate business requirements into robust application, service, and target-state architectures, including reusable RAG, agent orchestration, prompt, and evaluation patterns.

AI Quality, Security & Operations

Own evaluation strategy, including golden datasets, offline and online evaluation, human-calibrated LLM-as-judge, and CI regression testing.
Set retrieval quality standards for chunking, hybrid search, reranking, query rewriting, and permission-aware retrieval, using measured recall and precision.
Define AI security, privacy, Responsible AI, and governance controls, including prompt injection, data exfiltration, jailbreak, sandboxing, least-privilege identity, and supply-chain risks.
Own solution economics through model routing, caching, batching, capacity planning, and defensible cost-per-transaction estimates.
Support enterprise architecture standards and help assess technology solutions.

Leadership, Clients & Practice

Supervise vendor developers and mentor engineers and junior architects.
Support business development by identifying and researching opportunities with new and existing clients.
Improve internal design and development practices and maintain documentation.
Build internal relationships, strengthen the firm's reputation, and develop your skills in line with company and team priorities.
Take on additional responsibilities relevant to the role and agreed with your manager.

Experience

What You'll Bring

5+ years of experience in agile product delivery.
Hands-on experience designing and delivering production software solutions at scale.
Demonstrated expertise in Generative AI solution architecture.
You have personally delivered at least one Generative AI system to production and can explain its architecture, failure modes, operating costs, and lessons learned.

Education & Certifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Relevant Microsoft Azure certification, such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Developer Associate, is preferred.

Technical Skills & Specialized Knowledge

Strong hands-on experience with Generative AI architecture is essential. Experience across several relevant technologies is expected; expertise in every named tool is not required.

Generative AI & Agent Architecture

Large language models such as GPT-4, Gemini, and Llama.
RAG, agent orchestration, and Microsoft Copilots using platforms or frameworks such as Azure OpenAI Service, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.
Vector search and retrieval engineering, including chunking, hybrid search, reranking, query rewriting, metadata filtering, and permission-aware retrieval.
Production AI agents, including tool calls, state and memory management, durable execution, approval controls, retries, idempotency, and cost safeguards.
Structured generation, including schema-enforced outputs, validation and repair, deterministic fallbacks, and graceful degradation.

Cloud, Software & Data Engineering

Cloud-native Azure architecture, including Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI services, and appropriate infrastructure and platform services.
Service-oriented, event-driven, and microservices architectures.
Relational and NoSQL data stores, such as Microsoft SQL Server and MongoDB, with sound technology-selection judgement.
Containers and orchestration using Docker and/or Kubernetes.
DevOps and delivery practices, including CI/CD, automation, environment management, and tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub, or Jira.
Working knowledge of user-centred product practices, including user stories, personas, and prototyping.

jobs.description:
Job Purpose

As a Cloud Platform Engineer, you are part of the team responsible for delivering the internal cloud platform that enables our SaaS product teams to build, deploy, and operate reliably in Azure and AWS. This role focuses on building platform capabilities that are reusable, secure, observable, and easy to consume. You will engage in full lifecycle delivery from implementation and automation to hardening, supportability, and continuous improvement.

You’ll be working in an enablement team that treats platform components as versioned products, with stable interfaces, high documentation standards, and a relentless focus on reducing cognitive load and operational friction for R&D, Cloud Security, SRE and Cloud Operations teams. You will collaborate with these users to ensure consistent and efficient use of the platform.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver modular, secure, and reusable infrastructure components using Terraform, backed by automation pipelines and telemetry.
Implement platform capabilities such as Kubernetes clusters, ingress, networking, observability, data services, and identity integrations as standardized building blocks.
Embed operational resilience logging, metrics, alerting as default characteristics of the platform.
Integrate cloud security and compliance requirements (e.g., IAM boundaries, encryption, audit readiness) into the delivery pipeline in collaboration with the Cloud Security Operations team.
Develop internal APIs, CLI tools, or service wrappers that simplify infrastructure consumption and improve developer experience.
Maintain and evolve platform components through versioning, lifecycle policies, and continuous refactoring based on telemetry and platform feedback.
Providing documentation, usage examples, and onboarding guides is essential to facilitate the adoption of a platform and reduce the support burden. The ability to share knowledge and create comprehensive documentation are fundamental skills for a cloud platform engineer.
Participate in planning, refinement, and technical review sessions to align with platform architecture and cross-functional delivery priorities.
Act as a mentor and enabler for the Cloud Operations team members
Utilize AI-enabled tools (e.g., chatbots, documentation automation, analytics assistants) to improve efficiency, accuracy, and streamline routine tasks while following company AI governance and data privacy standards

Base salary range: For this role, based in Bulgaria, the base salary range is €25000-65000 per year, set using objective, gender-neutral job evaluation criteria applied to all employees performing this role or work of equal value.

Determining your actual pay: Your base salary within this range will be based on objective, gender-neutral factors — work location, skills, qualifications, experience, and education/training. It will not be reduced based on prior salary or negotiating position, nor will it fall below the range or below what colleagues in equal work receive.

Scope: This range covers base salary only, not bonuses, benefits, or other remuneration (as applicable).

Your rights: Tungsten Automation does not ask about current or past pay, and you need not disclose it. This notice does not limit your right to negotiate or your entitlement to equal pay for equal work or work of equal value.

While the job description describes what is anticipated as the requirements of the position, the job requirements are subject to change based upon any changing needs and requirements of the business.

Required Skills

Required Qualifications

Solid hands-on experience in infrastructure delivery or platform engineering roles in a cloud-native environment
Proficient with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices, working knowledge of CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
Experience developing tooling or platform components using a higher-level programming language such as Java, C#, or C++
Strong understanding of cloud services in Azure and/or AWS
Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration; familiarity with cluster provisioning and workload identity
Knowledge of securing infrastructure components and implementing policy-as-code.
Scripting and automation experience (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash)
Familiarity with observability concepts (logs, metrics, traces) and how to make them first-class in infrastructure
Strong collaboration and documentation skills; able to deliver structured solutions with a product mindset
Skills in prompting AI systems and assessing output quality
Ability to leverage AI to ideate, develop and scale to the needs of the department

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building internal platforms, golden paths, or self-service developer experiences.
Familiarity with GitOps workflows
Exposure to policy-as-code frameworks and configuration hardening standards (e.g., CIS benchmarks).
Experience working in regulated environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP) and integrating compliance into infrastructure delivery.
Understanding of platform SLOs, Error budgets, operational maturity models, and infrastructure lifecycle thinking.

As a successful Cloud Platform Engineer

You think in abstractions, not just scripts. You build for reusability, stability, and clarity knowing that your users are other engineers relying on your work to move faster and safer. You’re driven by delivery, not novelty, and thrive on solving operational complexity through design, automation, and simplification. You treat infrastructure the same way great product teams treat software as something to be designed, tested, versioned, and continuously improved.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Forward Deployed AI Engineer
new_jobs.description:
MongoDB is looking for an outstanding person to join our newly created Forward Deployed Engineering team and take on a key role in our extended R&D organization. Forward Deployed Engineering is linking the work of teams engaged on application modernization roles with our Product and Engineering teams.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

Many organizations have built up large estates of legacy applications. Lack of scalability and resilience, long development times, operating cost, and inability to run on cloud are common issues with these applications. To address these issues, organizations are engaging in large transformational Application Modernisation programs. MongoDB is recognized as the developer data platform of choice for transactional systems that provide the best scalability, resiliency and developer experience in the cloud as well as on premises. Organizations are continuously migrating workloads from these legacy applications to new platforms, often based on microservices, using MongoDB.

Such transformations are time intensive and often risky. Tooling based on generative AI promises to accelerate these transformations in a way never seen before. Forward Deployed Engineering is responsible for exploring the possibilities of Generative AI technologies and providing invaluable feedback to MongoDB’s R&D teams to drive future capabilities of MongoDB and the MongoDB ecosystem.

Application Modernization Engineers will work alongside project teams that are executing Application Modernisation projects with customers. The successful candidate will be responsible for evaluation, build, and applying tools in modernization projects, facilitating the usage of such tools and processes across the different project teams, identifying opportunities for tooling deployment, selecting potential 3rd party tools, contributing to the development of tooling prototypes and helping to shape the product roadmap.

Our ideal candidate will have

4+ years of experience as a field engineer or professional services consultant or full stack developer working directly with Enterprise clients
Proficiency in Java or C#, and some familiarity with common database access patterns and frameworks in one or more of these languages
Strong knowledge about enterprise-scale software architectures, application development methodologies, and software deployment and operations
Experience developing enterprise applications using relational databases, and employing SQL and stored procedures with Oracle, MS SQL Server, Sybase and/or PostgreSQL databases
Experience of using and developing with MongoDB and JSON based Document models is highly desirable
Problem solving skills, including the ability to collaborate across disciplines and teams to come up with creative solutions to technical and business challenges
Willingness to dive into a complex domain, ask the right questions, and bring new software tools and technologies to the table to solve customer problems
Great communication skills (both spoken and written), within the team and in customer meetings
Good understanding of Generative AI concepts, tools, and services. Any experience to build new applications/tools using Generative AI is a big plus. That includes Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini, and OpenAI APIs
And finally, a strong interest in how AI supported toolchains can improve application development

Position Expectations

Contribute to customer application modernization initiatives at any or all phases of the application lifecycle: assessment and analysis; planning and design; data modeling; application code conversion, development, test and build; integration and release configuration, production operations, application optimisation, and best practices adoption
Test drive MongoDB migration products to deliver on customer use cases and drive adoption of the product. Deliver concise feedback to the rest of the development organisation
Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to influence the direction of the MongoDB product roadmap
Personally execute POCs including developing or extending existing tools when necessary and appropriate for customer success, with an eye towards reusability and eventual integration with our products. These are often on premises at client locations
Maintain a broad and deep technical understanding of the product line and the underlying technologies and protocols
Work as part of a wider delivery team comprising consulting engineers from MongoDB Professional Services, project managers, and account teams
Assist sales teams in evaluating opportunities with prospects and customers
Willingness to work on site with customers for 7 days per month, which includes regional travel (within Europe)

Success Measures

The Senior Forward Deployed Engineer will be successful in this role when they can execute the following strategic tasks/responsibilities:

Become an expert level user of MongoDB, and our tools current migration products
Develop a playbook for customer application modernization engagements, in collaboration with other MongoDB Engineers, Product Management and Engineering
Communicate complex technical proposals simply and convincingly to a wide range of audiences
Provide unique insight into customer needs, product requirements and strategic opportunities by contributing experience from the field
Gain the reputation as a trusted advisor with our field teams and customers
Contribute to the success of customer application migration initiatives that they support

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager | Data Engineer & Cloud Analytics Barcelona
new_jobs.description:
¿Te imaginas participando en la transformación de las principales organizaciones nacionales e internacionales?

En Deloitte estamos comprometidos con generar un impacto en la sociedad, en nuestros clientes y en ti.

Sobre la posición

Buscamos incorporar un/a Gerente o Senior Manager de Consultoría Tecnológica para reforzar nuestro equipo de Ingeniería y Arquitectura de Datos .

La persona seleccionada tendrá un papel relevante en el crecimiento de la práctica, combinando desarrollo de negocio, liderazgo de clientes, definición de soluciones y dirección integral de proyectos de Data & Analytics . Buscamos un perfil con autonomía comercial, capacidad para gestionar iniciativas complejas y experiencia liderando equipos de consultoría en entornos tecnológicos exigentes.

Será responsable de impulsar oportunidades alrededor del dato, desarrollar relaciones de confianza con clientes y partners tecnológicos y asegurar la correcta ejecución técnica, económica y operativa de los proyectos bajo su responsabilidad.

¿Cuál será tu misión?

Contribuir al desarrollo de nuestra oferta de Data Engineering, Data Architecture y Cloud Analytics , liderando tanto la actividad comercial como la ejecución de proyectos y la evolución del equipo.

La posición combina cuatro dimensiones principales:

Desarrollo de negocio y gestión de grandes cuentas.
Dirección técnica y económica de proyectos.
Soporte a la definición de arquitecturas y soluciones de datos.
Liderazgo, desarrollo y crecimiento de equipos.

¿Qué responsabilidades asumirás?

Desarrollo de negocio y liderazgo comercial

Identificar, desarrollar y liderar oportunidades comerciales relacionadas con Data Engineering, Cloud Analytics, Data Platforms y Data Strategy .
Gestionar la relación con clientes, generando nuevas oportunidades y contribuyendo a la apertura y desarrollo de cuentas.
Liderar procesos de preventa y respuestas a RFP complejas y de gran envergadura .
Coordinar la elaboración de propuestas, estimaciones económicas, modelos de prestación y planes de trabajo.
Realizar defensas comerciales y técnicas ante interlocutores de negocio y tecnología.
Definir propuestas de valor y soluciones alrededor de:
Data Strategy y Data Assessments.
Modern Data Platforms y Data Lakes.
Arquitecturas de datos cloud, híbridas y on-premise.
Business Intelligence y Analytics.
DataOps y MLOps.
Plataformas de streaming y procesamiento en tiempo real.

Desarrollar relaciones con alianzas y partners tecnológicos, identificando oportunidades conjuntas de mercado.

Dirección de proyectos y gestión económica

Dirigir de forma concurrente una cartera aproximada de tres o cuatro proyectos .
Asegurar el cumplimiento de los compromisos de alcance, calidad, plazo y presupuesto.
Gestionar riesgos, dependencias, planificación, capacidad y carga de los equipos.
Realizar el seguimiento financiero de los proyectos, incluyendo ingresos, costes, margen, previsiones y desviaciones.
Mantener una interlocución ejecutiva con los clientes durante todo el ciclo de vida de los proyectos.
Participar en la resolución de situaciones críticas, facilitando la toma de decisiones y la definición de planes de acción.
Asegurar la calidad de los entregables y la coherencia de las soluciones con los objetivos del cliente.

Liderazgo técnico y de solución

Liderar la definición de arquitecturas y soluciones de datos desde una perspectiva de management, viabilidad, valor y posicionamiento comercial .
Orientar a los equipos en la selección de tecnologías, patrones arquitectónicos y modelos de implantación.
Conectar las necesidades de negocio con soluciones de ingeniería y arquitectura de datos escalables, seguras y sostenibles.
Participar en revisiones de arquitectura, estimaciones, planes de transición y hojas de ruta tecnológicas.
Identificar riesgos técnicos y operativos durante las fases de preventa y ejecución.

Gestión y desarrollo de equipos

Liderar equipos de entre 10 y 20 profesionales , con capacidad para asumir estructuras superiores a 20-25 personas a medida que crezca la práctica.
Coordinar managers, arquitectos, especialistas, consultores y perfiles de ingeniería.
Crear equipo y desarrollar capacidades, favoreciendo la incorporación, formación y evolución de nuevos profesionales.
Realizar seguimiento del desempeño, desarrollo profesional, asignación y cargabilidad de los equipos.
Promover la colaboración, la autonomía y la transmisión de conocimiento.
Actuar como referente para el equipo, generando metodología, buenas prácticas y una cultura de excelencia técnica y orientación al cliente.

¿Qué perfil buscamos?

Experiencia profesional

Experiencia previa de más de 2 años desempeñando funciones de Gerente en proyectos de Data, Analytics, Cloud o transformación tecnológica.
Experiencia contrastada en la dirección técnica y económica de proyectos de consultoría.
Experiencia gestionando simultáneamente varios proyectos, con responsabilidad sobre plazos, riesgos, presupuesto, margen y equipos.
Experiencia en el desarrollo y gestión de grandes cuentas.
Experiencia liderando preventas, propuestas y respuestas a RFP.
Capacidad para definir y defender arquitecturas y soluciones de datos ante interlocutores técnicos y ejecutivos.
Experiencia en gestión de equipos de más de 10 personas.
Se valorará experiencia gestionando una unidad, cartera de proyectos o cuenta con responsabilidad sobre su rendimiento económico.

Formación

Titulación universitaria en:
Ingeniería Informática.
Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones.
Ingeniería Industrial.
Matemáticas.
Física.
Otras titulaciones técnicas equivalentes.

Idiomas

Inglés fluido (b2/c1, preferiblemente c1). Debes ser capaz de liderar reuniones, defender una arquitectura y redactar documentación técnica compleja en inglés.
Capacidad para participar en propuestas, reuniones y presentaciones en entornos internacionales.

Conocimientos tecnológicos

Buscamos un perfil con visión amplia de las arquitecturas de datos y capacidad para tomar decisiones y liderar soluciones. No es imprescindible ser especialista técnico hands-on en todas las tecnologías, pero sí disponer de conocimiento suficiente para orientar propuestas, validar arquitecturas y mantener conversaciones de alto nivel con clientes y equipos técnicos.

Se valorará el grado de experiencia en los siguientes ámbitos:

Arquitecturas y plataformas de datos

Arquitecturas de Analytics en entornos cloud, híbridos y on-premise.
Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, Lakehouse y Modern Data Platforms.
Procesamiento batch, streaming y arquitecturas orientadas a eventos.
Integración, gobierno, seguridad y calidad del dato.
DataOps, DevOps y MLOps aplicados a plataformas de datos.

Cloud y plataformas analíticas

Microsoft Azure : Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Synapse Analytics, Azure SQL, Analysis Services, Databricks, Delta Lake y Power BI.
Google Cloud Platform : Cloud Storage, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery y herramientas de visualización del ecosistema Google Cloud.
Amazon Web Services : AWS Lambda, Glue, S3, Redshift, Athena, Redshift Spectrum y Kinesis.
Snowflake .
Databricks .

Ingeniería e integración de datos

Apache Kafka, Kafka Connect y tecnologías de procesamiento de eventos.
Ecosistemas Hadoop y plataformas como Cloudera.
Bases de datos SQL, incluyendo Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server y MySQL.
Herramientas y patrones de integración, transformación y explotación de datos.

Certificaciones valorables

Se valorarán certificaciones profesionales relacionadas con:

Microsoft Azure.
Google Cloud Platform.
Amazon Web Services.
Snowflake.
Databricks.
Gestión de servicios y proyectos, como ITIL o PMP .

Las certificaciones serán consideradas un elemento positivo, aunque se priorizará la experiencia real en gestión de clientes, desarrollo comercial, liderazgo de equipos y dirección de proyectos.

Competencias clave

Orientación al cliente

Capacidad para comprender las prioridades del cliente, construir relaciones de confianza y convertir necesidades de negocio en iniciativas y soluciones concretas.

Comunicación e influencia

Comunicación ejecutiva, clara y convincente. Capacidad para presentar y defender propuestas ante responsables de negocio, CIO, CDO, responsables de arquitectura y equipos técnicos.

Autonomía comercial

Capacidad para desarrollar relaciones con clientes, abrir oportunidades, movilizar equipos internos y liderar defensas comerciales con poca dependencia de terceros.

Capacidad comercial

Experiencia liderando RFP complejas, articulando propuestas de valor, definiendo soluciones y coordinando los componentes técnicos, económicos y operativos de una oferta.

Liderazgo

Capacidad para dirigir equipos multidisciplinares, delegar responsabilidades, desarrollar talento y acompañar el crecimiento de la práctica.

Trabajo en equipo

Orientación a crear capacidad sostenible, compartir conocimiento y generar una comunidad de profesionales alrededor de la ingeniería y arquitectura de datos.

Gestión económica

Solidez en la elaboración y seguimiento de presupuestos, estimaciones, márgenes, previsiones, asignaciones y planes de capacidad.

Iniciativa y proactividad

Capacidad para anticipar necesidades, identificar oportunidades y tomar decisiones en contextos complejos o con información incompleta.

Visión tecnológica y de negocio

Capacidad para valorar una solución no solo por su adecuación técnica, sino también por su viabilidad económica, escalabilidad, impacto y alineamiento con la estrategia del cliente.

Otros requisitos

Flexibilidad para trabajar con diferentes industrias, clientes y equipos.
Capacidad para desenvolverse en entornos de crecimiento, transformación y elevada exigencia.
Orientación a resultados, calidad y generación de impacto.

¿Cómo es trabajar en Deloitte?

🤩 Proyectos de alto impacto
donde tendrás un largo recorrido y aprendizaje

☯️ Un día a día híbrido-flexible:

⚽ Buen ambiente dentro y fuera de la oficina:
disfrutarás de varios teambuildings al año, actividades culturales y deportivas… ¡y mucho más!

🧘‍♀️ Bienestar integral:
cuídate con nuestro programa de salud física, mental y financiera… ¡y con equipo médico en las oficinas!

🤲 Impacto social:
Podrás apuntarte a una gran cantidad de voluntariados de alcance nacional e internacional y a proyectos pro-bono con los que poner tu tiempo y talento al servicio de quienes más lo necesitan

🗣️ Cultura del feedback y aprendizaje continuo:
crecerás en un entorno inclusivo donde la igualdad de oportunidades y tu plan personalizado de formación impulsarán tu desarrollo. ¿Ya te visualizas en la Deloitte University de París?

🤝 Beneficios exclusivos por ser parte de Deloitte:
podrás disfrutar de un gran catálogo de beneficios y de un completo plan de retribución flexible

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about — in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant. 

Based in the beautiful city of Porto, you’ll be part of our collaborative Engineering & Development teams, working closely with your peers and decision-makers to maintain and develop our global services and products.

As a Software Engineer, you are a builder who bridges the gap between high-level requirements and high-performance reality. Having advanced past foundational concepts, you are currently dedicated to growing your expertise in designing distributed systems that scale effectively. You don't just write code that works; you write code that thrives under the pressure of global data scales.

You will be an integral part of the development cycle, owning features from design to deployment. Working within an agile team, you’ll encounter exciting technical challenges, from low-latency optimizations to complex B2B integrations, in a culture where your voice is heard and your growth is prioritized.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Service Evolution:
Develop and maintain our core backend and middleware services, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and ready for global traffic.

Architectural Input:
Don't just follow blueprints, help draw them. By collaborating with more senior colleagues, you’ll participate in the design of software architectures that solve real-world business problems.

Data at Scale:
Write highly efficient code capable of handling massive amounts of data with ease.

Performance Engineering:
Implement performance-critical and low-latency solutions where every millisecond counts.

Production Insight:
Keep the services you build healthy in production. You'll instrument, monitor, and log them, then use those signals to debug real live issues, with support from the team as you ramp up.

Collaborative Growth:
Work within a peer-led environment where you’ll receive mentorship to constantly level up the team’s collective skill set.

Code Craftsmanship:
Actively participate in code reviews, advocating for "clean code" principles and maintainability.

Global Integration:
Build and support B2B integrations with partners and clients across the world, ensuring our data flows seamlessly across the ecosystem.

WHO YOU ARE

The Foundation:
You hold a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or have a similar technical background. You have 2+ years of professional experience in a comparable software engineering role.

OOP Specialist:
You have a strong grasp of Object-Oriented Programming and understand how to apply design patterns to keep complex systems manageable.

Comfortable with .NET (or eager to learn):
You are comfortable using .NET/C# or similar C based languages
. While we value core engineering principles, you’ll be hitting the ground running in a working .NET environment.

Distributed Thinker:
You have "hands-on" experience (or a very strong conceptual understanding) of Microservices and how they communicate in a distributed world.

Tooling Savvy:
You are a fluent Git user and feel right at home in a terminal, perhaps even wielding PowerShell or Bash to automate your daily workflow.

Clean Code Advocate:
You believe that code is read more often than it is written. You take pride in naming, structure, and documentation. You recognize technical debt when you see it and work with the team to chip away at it.

Test-Minded:
You treat automated tests as part of “done”, not an afterthought. You write tests alongside your code so it stays robust and so the next person can change it safely.

Security & Privacy Conscious:
You apply basic security and privacy principles by default, handle user data responsibly without exception, and raise a flag early when you spot a concern.

Agile Mindset:
You thrive in a collaborative environment. You understand that "Agile" is about iterative value, transparency, and constant feedback. You can size and prioritize your own work with input from the team, and you raise a hand early when something drifts off track.

Great Communicator:
You have strong conversational English skills (written and spoken) and enjoy the dynamic of working with colleagues from different time zones and cultures.

new_jobs.title: Cloud Platform Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Job Purpose

As a Cloud Platform Engineer, you are part of the team responsible for delivering the internal cloud platform that enables our SaaS product teams to build, deploy, and operate reliably in Azure and AWS. This role focuses on building platform capabilities that are reusable, secure, observable, and easy to consume. You will engage in full lifecycle delivery from implementation and automation to hardening, supportability, and continuous improvement.

You’ll be working in an enablement team that treats platform components as versioned products, with stable interfaces, high documentation standards, and a relentless focus on reducing cognitive load and operational friction for R&D, Cloud Security, SRE and Cloud Operations teams. You will collaborate with these users to ensure consistent and efficient use of the platform.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver modular, secure, and reusable infrastructure components using Terraform, backed by automation pipelines and telemetry.
Implement platform capabilities such as Kubernetes clusters, ingress, networking, observability, data services, and identity integrations as standardized building blocks.
Embed operational resilience logging, metrics, alerting as default characteristics of the platform.
Integrate cloud security and compliance requirements (e.g., IAM boundaries, encryption, audit readiness) into the delivery pipeline in collaboration with the Cloud Security Operations team.
Develop internal APIs, CLI tools, or service wrappers that simplify infrastructure consumption and improve developer experience.
Maintain and evolve platform components through versioning, lifecycle policies, and continuous refactoring based on telemetry and platform feedback.
Providing documentation, usage examples, and onboarding guides is essential to facilitate the adoption of a platform and reduce the support burden. The ability to share knowledge and create comprehensive documentation are fundamental skills for a cloud platform engineer.
Participate in planning, refinement, and technical review sessions to align with platform architecture and cross-functional delivery priorities.
Act as a mentor and enabler for the Cloud Operations team members
Utilize AI-enabled tools (e.g., chatbots, documentation automation, analytics assistants) to improve efficiency, accuracy, and streamline routine tasks while following company AI governance and data privacy standards

Base salary range: For this role, based in Bulgaria, the base salary range is €25000-65000 per year, set using objective, gender-neutral job evaluation criteria applied to all employees performing this role or work of equal value.

Determining your actual pay: Your base salary within this range will be based on objective, gender-neutral factors — work location, skills, qualifications, experience, and education/training. It will not be reduced based on prior salary or negotiating position, nor will it fall below the range or below what colleagues in equal work receive.

Scope: This range covers base salary only, not bonuses, benefits, or other remuneration (as applicable).

Your rights: Tungsten Automation does not ask about current or past pay, and you need not disclose it. This notice does not limit your right to negotiate or your entitlement to equal pay for equal work or work of equal value.

While the job description describes what is anticipated as the requirements of the position, the job requirements are subject to change based upon any changing needs and requirements of the business.

Required Skills

Required Qualifications

Solid hands-on experience in infrastructure delivery or platform engineering roles in a cloud-native environment
Proficient with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices, working knowledge of CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
Experience developing tooling or platform components using a higher-level programming language such as Java, C#, or C++
Strong understanding of cloud services in Azure and/or AWS
Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration; familiarity with cluster provisioning and workload identity
Knowledge of securing infrastructure components and implementing policy-as-code.
Scripting and automation experience (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash)
Familiarity with observability concepts (logs, metrics, traces) and how to make them first-class in infrastructure
Strong collaboration and documentation skills; able to deliver structured solutions with a product mindset
Skills in prompting AI systems and assessing output quality
Ability to leverage AI to ideate, develop and scale to the needs of the department

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building internal platforms, golden paths, or self-service developer experiences.
Familiarity with GitOps workflows
Exposure to policy-as-code frameworks and configuration hardening standards (e.g., CIS benchmarks).
Experience working in regulated environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP) and integrating compliance into infrastructure delivery.
Understanding of platform SLOs, Error budgets, operational maturity models, and infrastructure lifecycle thinking.

As a successful Cloud Platform Engineer

You think in abstractions, not just scripts. You build for reusability, stability, and clarity knowing that your users are other engineers relying on your work to move faster and safer. You’re driven by delivery, not novelty, and thrive on solving operational complexity through design, automation, and simplification. You treat infrastructure the same way great product teams treat software as something to be designed, tested, versioned, and continuously improved.
